name: 3 Drop Weightless Serum Foundation
description:
3 Drop Weightless Serum Foundation
This product is: A weightless serum foundation with buildable medium-coverage and a glowy natural finish. Created with a hyper-potent new fermented carotenoid active for radiant skin. 
Good for: All skin types
Why we love it: Rituel de Fille 3 Drop Weightless Serum Foundation offers the complexion you want from a buildable medium-coverage foundation, the ease you want from a tinted oil, and the ingredients you want from a serum–all in one formula unlike anything you have tried before. 
A real foundation that wears like skincare, with wear so lightweight it feels like nothing at all. With a high concentration of organic marula oil, and organic jojoba oil as the first ingredient, this skin-supporting serum foundation creates the perfect glowy natural finish. Never sticky, never greasy, and never drying. 
This innovative cruelty-free and vegan formula is made with skincare actives at an effective concentration to support radiance and firmness, even skin tone, and protect the skin barrier. 3 Drop Foundation is the first-ever product in any category–including skincare–to be created with JD Phyto-Or 1%, a hyper-potent new carotenoid active from pure fermented phytoene. 
JD Phyto-Or 1% combines pure fermented phytoene with organic jojoba oil. Phytoene has never before been available in an isolated form. Created through a patent-pending new process, this isolated phytoene is produced through mycelial fermentation using non-GMO vegetable oils in a zero-waste process. As a uniquely colorless carotenoid, phytoene can be used at higher concentrations for greater efficacy compared to carotenoids like beta-carotein and lycopene. 
In clinical trials, JD Phyto-Or 1% has demonstrated significant, measurable improvements in radiance, firmness, elasticity, and evenness of skin tone, while also soothing the skin, protecting from pollution, and supporting the hydro-lipid barrier. JD Phyto-Or 1% is natural, non-comedogenic and safe for all skin types.
Rituel de Fille 3 Drop Weightless Serum Foundation is available in 24 shades:

description:
3 Drop Weightless Serum Foundation works like magic for a truly transformative yet utterly natural effect. This innovative formula smooths and unifies the complexion, yet is as weightless and intuitively easy to apply as a serum. The remarkable medium-coverage formula imparts a softly diffused, subtly luminous finish.
3 Drop Weightless Serum Foundation is the first product to market in any category, including skincare, to contain the truly innovative and sustainable new active carotenoid ingredient: fermented phytoene. This is the first pure phytoene ever extracted, and this ingredient offers both remarkable short-term and long-term benefits. Clinical trials have shown it to protect against free radicals, brighten and smooth skin, enhance firmness and elasticity, and support the skin barrier among its many long-term benefits.

name: Cream Foundation
description:
Lily Lolo Cream Foundation is infused with nourishing jojoba and argan oils making it the perfect choice for normal to dry skin types but also great for sensitive skin or skin prone to breakouts. The lightweight and easy-to-blend formula means that you can apply with a brush, sponge or even the fingertips.  
HOW TO USE IT
Using either your fingers or a brush simply apply first to the areas that need more coverage (cheeks and chin) and blend outwards. Coverage can be built up. Set with your favorite finishing powder.
INGREDIENTS
Superpower Ingredients
Argan, Jojoba, Sunflower
Full Ingredient List
Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Copernicia Cerifera (Carnuba) Cera, Kaolin, Simmondsia Chinensis (Jojoba) Seed Oil, Mica, Helianthus Annuus (Sunflower) Seed Oil, Vitis Vinifera (Grape) Seed Oil, Boron NitrideI, Argania Spinosa (Argan) Kernel Oil, Tocopherol, [+/- CI 77891 (Titanium Dioxide), CI 77491, CI 77492, CI 77499 (Iron Oxides)]
ABOUT THIS BRAND
Lily Lolo Mineral Cosmetics is a thoughtfully formulated makeup line made in England designed with the goal of delivering healthy, high-performing, beautiful cosmetics without compromise. Founder, Vikki Khan, first fell in love with mineral makeup many years ago but found that she could not find the perfect lightweight foundation in a healthy formula that worked for her. This inspired her to create Lily Lolo which today is an award-winning mineral cosmetics line that has achieved cult status around the world.

name: Serum Foundation - 3.3-r - 30ml
description:
Our Serum Foundation delivers moderate coverage without a heavy-makeup look. Engineered to spread easily and blend seamlessly, the serum-like formulation has a real-skin finish and is compatible with most primers. The high-spreadability suspension system offers a natural look and resists collecting in fine lines. This formulation is designed to be suitable for all skin types and available in a range of 36 shades.

The shades are divided into four categories:
1 for lighter tones
2 for medium tones
3 for dark/deep tones
4 for deeper tones.

Each category is then classified further by a second digit from 0 to 4 to indicate depth within each category.

name: Blurring Ceramide Cream Foundation
mpn: MOB BEAUTY - Blurring Ceramide Cream Foundation - PINK 20
description: Winner of Cosmopolitan’s Best Clean Foundation of 2024, this skincare powered vegan cream foundation and concealer hybrid blurs the skin with a multi-dimensional mineral technology that gives a radiant light bounce and natural skin finish with flexible coverage. Ceramide 2 holds moisture in the skin and repairs the skin barrier during wear, and an award-winning small molecule hyaluronic acid visibly plumps and hydrates leaving skin looking supple, nourished, and refreshed. Avocado oil gives the formula creamy blendability while natural sugar polymers offers flexible comfort, skin adhesion, and long wear. Anti-inflammatories bisabolol from chamomile and Phytosphingosine calm the skin and soothe redness, and the unique waterless formula stays color true all day. The compact is biodegradable.

name: Blurring Ceramide Cream Foundation
description:
Blurring Ceramide Cream Foundation 
This product is: An award winning, skin care-infused cream foundation with flexible coverage and a blurring, natural-radiant skin finish.
Good for: All Skin types. Hypoallergenic & gluten free.
Why we love it: MOB Beauty Blurring Ceramide Cream Foundation is a skincare powered cream foundation and concealer hybrid that blurs the skin with a multi-dimensional mineral technology that gives a radiant light bounce and natural skin finish.   
Ceramide 2 holds moisture in the skin and repairs the skin barrier during wear, and a small molecule hyaluronic acid visibly plumps and hydrates leaving skin looking supple, nourished, and refreshed. Avocado oil gives the formula creamy blendability while natural sugar polymers offers flexible comfort, skin adhesion, and long wear. Anti-inflammatories Bisabolol and Phytosphingosine calm the skin and soothe redness, and the unique waterless formula stays color true all day.
The Blurring Ceramide Cream Foundation compact is sustainably designed with 90% post - consumer recycled fiber and can be recycled or simply thrown away after the eyeshadow pan is removed because the compact is biodegradable! The foundation pan is made with 100% post - consumer recycled PET and can be popped out of the compact and easily snapped into MOB’s endlessly refillable and infinitely customizable palettes allowing you to build your own customizable, convenient, all in one palette.
 MOB Beauty Blurring Ceramide Cream Foundation is available in 26 shades:

A fresh, water-based foundation formula with smoothing and anti-pollution skincare ingredients that blur imperfections and leave skin looking flawless. This cushion foundation is lightweight and instantly perfecting, the refillable soft cushion foundation compact makes building coverage beautifully simple. Apply with the puff for a natural, fresh finish or apply with your fingers for even more ease.
Created to support the Sheldrick Wildlife Trust's orphan baby elephant rescue program.
Shades That StretchWhat makes this formula so unique is its flexibility. One shade has the versatility to work with multiple skin tones, making it our most inclusive foundation to date.
Use our Foundation Quiz to find your ideal formula and shade.





Want to find your perfect shade? Our virtual consultant can match you with your true hue. Book now







Each compact contains one inserted cushion and one refill cushion in a sealed pouch. Do not open refill until ready to insert into the compact.

description:
The creamy foundation lends the skin natural luminosity while jojoba and organ oils supply dry to normal skin types with needed moisture. A light-weight, easy-to-use cream foundation that can be applied with a foundation brush, sponge or your fingertips.

Application:

Apply the foundation to the centre of the face using your make-up tool of choice and blend the product outwards for a flawless finish.
Tip: Apply the product once the moisturiser or primer is fully absorbed by the skin.

name: Ultra Radiance Liquid Foundation SPF 20
description:
Release the light. Glow like a jewel with every luxurious drop of this extraordinary liquid makeup.

Captured in every bottle: the radiant power of 2 precious Peridot stones*, helping boost skin's natural energy for renewed vibrancy**. Plus millions of micro-fine gems to help create a flawless, jewel-like finish.

Powerfully infused with Re-Nutriv's advanced skincare technology, it leaves skin soft, supple and smooth. Skin looks more even. Imperfections and pores seem to disappear.

The silky, fluid texture infuses long lasting moisture to keep skin looking fresh and dewy. Flawless, perfected finish stays color-true. Long-wearing. Humidity-resistant.

With SPF 20, helps defend against UVA and UVB rays, helping maintain skin's elasticity and density and prevent the appearance of lines and wrinkles.

Reveal your skin's infinite beauty.

ENERGIZING PERIDOT STONE
Estée Lauder Research has shown this translucent green gem helps boost skin's natural energy for renewed vibrancy and radiance.**

To add to its mysterious power, millions of micro-fine gems, including sapphires and rubies, interact with light to create delicate nuances of illumination.

Transform your skin with the look of pure light streaming through precious gems for a flawless, jewel-like radiance.

Re-Nutriv. Live a life of extraordinary beauty.

*Based on the average weight of our Peridot stones.
**In vitro testing.

name: Luminous Silk Natural Glow Blurring Foundation with 24 Hour Wear
description:
Item #20664210

What It Is:
A silky, lightweight foundation that blurs and smooths skin instantly for a natural glow finish with medium, buildable coverage. Designed to hydrate and last 24 hours, it delivers a luminous complexion that looks effortlessly radiant.

What It Does:
This foundation combines the iconic silky texture with a fresh formula enhanced by niacinamide—clinically proven to even skin tone, refine texture, and boost luminosity after 14 days. It flawlessly suits a wide range of skin intensities and tones. The long-lasting, transfer-resistant formula keeps your perfect shade true all day long. Dermatologist tested and safe for all skin types, including sensitive and acne-prone.

Coverage: Medium, buildable
Finish: Natural, luminous
Wear: 24-hour hydration and long-lasting
Key Ingredients: Niacinamide for skin tone correction and radiance

How to Use:
For a seamless, airbrushed finish, apply foundation to the center of your face and blend outward with a foundation brush. For a glowing, dewy effect, use a damp makeup sponge. Build coverage by layering as needed for a flawless, natural look.

1-oz.

name: Airbrush Flawless Foundation
description:
What it is: A stay-all-day, full coverage foundation with a natural-matte finish.

What it does: Unlock the secret to flawless, poreless-looking skin with the iconic Airbrush Flawless Foundation! It's a stay all day, weightless, full coverage science and color formula with a natural matte finish and instant airbrush effect. Bottling the famous smoothing, pore-blurring airbrush effects and the skin-care benefits of a serum, it contains Charlotte's magic matrix of hydrating, anti-aging and anti-pollution ingredients!

Key ingredients:

- 2% Replexium™: helps significantly reduce the appearance of wrinkles over time.

- Magic MossCellTec™: boosts hydration

- C.T. Defense™: a power peptide that defends against urban pollution

- Air Cool™: for a lasting fresh-feel to combat the effects of humidity and sweat

How to use: Apply Airbrush Flawless Foundation using a complexion brush (sold separately), buffing it in from the centre for a flawless-looking complexion.

name: Clinique Even Better Makeup Broad Spectrum SPF 15 Foundation - 1oz - Ulta Beauty
description:
Clinique Even Better™ Makeup Broad Spectrum SPF 15 helps create a brighter skin tone. After 12 weeks of daily wear, dark spots from acne, age, and sun damage are reduced. Creamy formula hydrates and smooths, gives skin a natural finish. Broad spectrum SPF 15 protects against future discoloration. Stay-true pigments won’t change color on your skin. Sweat and humidity-resistant. Non-acnegenic. Dermatologist and ophthalmologist tested.

Free Of
Paraben-free, Phthalate-free, Fragrance-free, Free of denatured alcohol, Free of synthetic colors, SLS-free, SLES-free, Gluten-free

How To Use
Start in center of face, blending outward.
Build coverage as needed.
Remove with your favorite Clinique makeup remover.

name: Teint Idole Ultra Wear 24H Full Coverage Foundation
description:
New Teint Idole Ultra Wear is our thinnest most breathable foundation giving you buildable coverage ranging from medium to full with a natural matte finish. Waterproof and sweat and humidity resistant this foundation delivers up to 24 hours of longwear powered by Advanced Airwear Technology™, giving you transfer-proof coverage that will last all day and night.

Our inclusive shade range is available in up to 50 shades across fair, light, medium, medium-to-deep, and deep intensities. This newly-renovated formula was crafted by Lancôme scientists to help people with deep and olive skin tones find their skin-like shade match.

What it does:
This full-coverage foundation seamlessly leaves your skin with a flawless natural-matte finish that is lightweight and breathable with the benefit of buildable full coverage that will stay all day without fading or transferring. Deep shades were enhanced by the pigment Ultra Marine Blue, resulting in pure, deep shades without a gray cast. For olive skin tones, the pigment Chromium Oxide Green was used to create shades that aren't too yellow or orange. Teint Idole Ultra Wear Foundation is made for all skin tones and skin types, even sensitive skin.

Benefits:

Natural-Matte Foundation
Buildable Full Coverage
Transfer, Sweat Resistant, Waterproof
Up to 24hr wear*
Fragrance-free
Formulated without mineral oils
Non-comedogenic
Suitable for all skin types, including sensitive
Ultra Marine Blue and Chromium Oxide Green pigments enhance deep and olive shades
Infused with Hyaluronic Acid, Moringa seed extract, Vitamin E, and Prebiotics
Tested Under Dermatological Control

*In a Consumer Study

How to Apply:

Step 1: Prep your skin with Advanced Génifique Face Serum for added hydration.
Step 2: For long wear and a smoother canvas, apply an oil-free La Base Pro primer.
Step 3: Apply Teint Idole Ultra Wear Foundation with your favorite tool

-Apply with a brush for maximum coverage and a flawless result
-Apply with a damp sponge for medium-to-full coverage with a dewy finish
-Apply with fingers for the lightest application and a barely-there look

Pro tip: For a radiant finish, mix a drop of Advanced Génifique Face Serum or your favorite moisturizer with your foundation before applying.
Teint Idole Ultra Wear shade intensities range from fair to deep:
100s = Fair200s = Light300s = Medium400s = Medium-to-Deep
500s = Deep

name: Danessa Myricks Yummy Skin Serum Foundation
description:
What it is:
This lightweight, hybrid foundation contains ingredients known to balance hydration and moisture while protecting skin with free radical-fighting antioxidants. The danessa myricks beauty yummy skin serum foundation is designed to deliver skincare benefits while enhancing your complexion with a radiant finish.
Benefits:
This nourishing formula addresses common skin concerns for comfortable, everyday wear. Packaging is refillable (refill sold separately).
• Liquid formula
• Medium buildable coverage
• Radiant finish
• Vegan & clean
• Formulated with hyaluronic acid, antioxidants and skin-loving oils
• Paraben-free, sulfate-free, cruelty-free
Good for:
• Hyperpigmentation
• Dryness
• Dark circles
• Uneven Texture
• Fine lines + wrinkles
• Balancing sebum
• Skin Types: Dry | Oily | Combination | Normal | Acne-prone | Sensitive | Mature
Key Ingredients:
Jojoba Oil deeply moisturizes and softens skin
Hyaluronic Acid hydrates and plumps fine lines and wrinkles
Olive-derived Squalene is known to balance oil production and offer visibly anti-aging properties.
How to use:
For Light Coverage:Squeeze a pea-sized amount and apply in even layers using fingers, brush or sponge.
For Medium Coverage:Squeeze two pea-sized amounts and apply in even layers using a brush or sponge.
Pro-tip:


Start from the center of the face and blend outwards for even application.
Layer over Yummy Skin Glow Serum for an added boost of radiance for the ultimate healthy, glowing complexion.
When you've squeezed the last drop, unscrew the empty cartridge from the bottle base and bottle dispenser cap.
Unbox a new refill cartridge and remove both the lid and protective seal.
Screw the new refill cartridge back into the bottle base and bottle dispenser cap.
Resume use by squeezing the cartridge until product is dispensed.

The danessa myricks beauty yummy skin serum foundation offers buildable coverage that feels lightweight while delivering a luminous, skin-enhancing effect suitable for daily wear.
Ingredients:
Hydrogenated Polyisobutene, Ethylhexyl Palmitate, Phenyl Trimethicone, Tridecyl Trimellitate, Diisostearyl Malate, Simmondsia Chinensis (Jojoba) Seed Oil, Olive Squalane, Silica Dimethyl Silylate, Ethylene/ Propylene/ Styrene Copolymer, Isododecane, Linum Usitatissimum (Linseed) Seed Oil, Passiflora Edulis Seed Oil, Salvia Hispanica Seed Oil, Tocopheryl Acetate, Hydrolyzed Sodium Hyaluronate, Limnanthes Alba (Meadowfoam) Seed Oil, Curcuma Longa (Turmeric) Root Oil, Curcumin, Zingiber Officinale (Ginger) Root Extract, Bentonite, Glyceryl Behenate, Alcohol, Parfum, May Contain/ Peut Contenir (+/-): Titanium Dioxide (Ci 77891),Iron Oxides (Ci 77491, Ci 77492, Ci 77499), Yellow 5 (Ci 19140)

name: HD SKIN FOUNDATION
description:
HD Skin Foundation from Make Up For Ever with 3 years in the making with over 30 worldwide professional Make Up Artists to create their best ever HD foundation!
40 Inclusive shades categorised into 3 undertones & 4 shade levels.
24 hour long wear that is also smudge, sweat and water proof makeup.
Pro friendly colour co-ordinated lids make the shades really easy to differentiate when working from your kit: The lid colours represent the 4 different shade families making it easier to select the correct foundation tone from your collection.
CHOOSE YOUR PERFECT SHADE IN 3 SIMPLE STEPS! 
Step 1: Firstly, pick your shade family, this is the first prefixed number and relates to the skin harmony level in which you fit best: 1= Light, 2= Medium, 3= Tan, 4= Deep. Image #3 will help you with this.
Step 2: Choose your undertone (this is the second letter), refer to the description on image#5 for help determining this. R = Red, N = Neutral, Y = Yellow
Step 3: Choose which intensity, use the models face charts (images #6, 7 & 8) to guide you as you choose the one which closest resembles your complexion.
For example- shade 2N34 would suit a medium skin with neutral/no strong or definate red or yellow undertones.
Formula:
An advanced formula that provides a flawless, undetectable finish for ultra realistic results. Contains high pigmentation for a superior level of correction whilst remaining invisible due to the beautifully lightweight, liquid consistency.
The revolutionary Micro Skin system consists of a light and flexible microscopic mesh formula that syncs to your skin for optimum results. It learns your skins movements for long wear with no caking or patchiness.
Combines micro fine powders to provide a blurring and perfecting result.
Does not oxidise.
The liquid formula means no cakey finishes, no rough texture or dry patches, just a really ultra natural, comfortable wear, true skin result.
Provides a buildable coverage that can range from medium to full depending on application and preference.   
Remains stable for up to 24 hours and blurs the complexion beautifully for up to 12 hours.
HD Skin Foundation is suitable for most skin types: oily, combination & normal.
If you are looking for a foundation more suited to a drier, mature skin then you can adapt the HD Skin by using extra nourishing skincare to prep such as Embryolisse Lait Creme Concentrate moisturiser (which also works as a good primer underneath makeup) and the Step 1 Hydra Booster Primer.
Alternatively the Make Up For Ever HD Skin Hydra Glow Foundation is particularly well suited to drier complexions.    
Provides a stunningly natural soft, semi matte finish that still keeps the skin looking luminous and fresh.  
30ml. Pump bottle.

Ethical Qualities:

Contains no animal derived ingredients.
Silicone free formula.
Rated green on the French Yuka app.    
Vegan.
Recycled & recyclable glass bottle.
Bio sourced cap.
FSC outer box.

name: Re-Nutriv Ultra Radiance Liquid Makeup SPF 20
description:
Item #20035294

What It Is:
A luxurious liquid makeup infused with the radiant power of Peridot, with medium to full coverage, lasting moisture, and a flawless, jewel-like finish.

What It Does:
Release the light. Glow like a jewel with every luxurious drop of this extraordinary liquid makeup.

Captured in every bottle: the radiant power of 2 precious Peridot stones*, helping boost skin's natural energy for renewed vibrancy**. Plus millions of micro-fine gems to help create a flawless, jewel-like finish.

Powerfully infused with Re-Nutriv's advanced skincare technology, it leaves skin soft, supple, and smooth. Skin looks more even. Imperfections and pores seem to disappear.

The silky, fluid texture infuses long-lasting moisture to keep skin looking fresh and dewy. The flawless, perfected finish stays color-true. Long-wearing. Humidity-resistant.

SPF 20 helps defend against UVA and UVB rays, helping maintain skin's elasticity and density and prevent the appearance of lines and wrinkles.

Reveal your skin's infinite beauty.

ENERGIZING PERIDOT STONE
Estee Lauder Research has shown this translucent green gem helps boost skin’s natural energy for renewed vibrancy and radiance.**
To add to its mysterious power, millions of micro-fine gems, including sapphires and rubies, interact with light to create delicate nuances of illumination.
Transform your skin with the look of pure light streaming through precious gems for a flawless, jewel-like radiance.
Re-Nutriv. Live a life of extraordinary beauty.

Features and Benefits:

Look radiant: luxurious liquid foundation.
Flawless Radiant Finish
Medium to Full Coverage
Long-wearing
Color-true
Instant and lasting moisture
Humidity-resistant
Covers pores
SPF 20
Dermatologist-tested
Non-acnegenic; won't clog pores

How to Use:

Shake well.
Smooth the liquid foundation over the skin.
Start at the center of the face and blend outward.
Add a little more to build a full coverage foundation.

*Based on the average weight of our Peridot stones. **In vitro testing.

description:
This cream is your all-in-one full-coverage foundation, hydrating and anti-aging serum, and broad-spectrum sunscreen in a travel friendly size.
Infused with skin-loving ingredients like hyaluronic acid, niacinamide and vitamin E, CC cream provides hydration while instantly camouflaging the look of skin imperfections like acne scarring, wrinkles, redness on skin, dark circles under eyes, large pores and uneven skin tone for flawless-looking natural coverage.

All-in-one complexion perfection with a natural finish
Full-coverage foundation
Hydrating and anti-aging serum
SPF 50+ broad-spectrum sunscreen

name: 3 Drop Weightless Serum Foundation
description:
Foundation that feels like skincare

3 Drop Weightless Serum Foundation works like magic for a truly transformative yet utterly natural effect. This innovative formula smooths and unifies the complexion, yet is as weightless and intuitively easy to apply as a serum. The remarkable medium-coverage formula imparts a softly diffused, subtly luminous finish.
3 Drop Weightless Serum Foundation is the first product to market in any category, including skincare, to contain the truly innovative and sustainable new active carotenoid ingredient: fermented phytoene. This is the first pure phytoene ever extracted, and this ingredient offers both remarkable short-term and long-term benefits. Clinical trials have shown it to protect against free radicals, brighten and smooth skin, enhance firmness and elasticity, and support the skin barrier among its many long-term benefits.

LEAPING BUNNY CERTIFIED CRUELTY-FREE | MADE IN LOS ANGELES | NOURISHING, SKIN-LOVING INGREDIENTS

name: Serum Foundation - 4.1-r - 30ml
description:
Our Serum Foundation delivers moderate coverage without a heavy-makeup look. Engineered to spread easily and blend seamlessly, the serum-like formulation has a real-skin finish and is compatible with most primers. The high-spreadability suspension system offers a natural look and resists collecting in fine lines. This formulation is designed to be suitable for all skin types and available in a range of 36 shades.

The shades are divided into four categories:
1 for lighter tones
2 for medium tones
3 for dark/deep tones
4 for deeper tones.

Each category is then classified further by a second digit from 0 to 4 to indicate depth within each category.
Finally, a letter is added to the shade code to identify the undertone:
P (Pink) and R (Red) indicate cool...

name: HAUS LABS BY LADY GAGA Triclone Skin Tech Medium Coverage Foundation with Fermented Arnica
description:
What it is: A medium coverage, weightless, non-comedogenic foundation with fermented arnica that helps reduce redness and protects from environmental stress.

Coverage: Medium

Finish: Natural

Formulation: Liquid

Highlighted Ingredients:

- Fermented Arnica: helps visibly reduces redness and irritation.

- Intellizen 7 Complex: proprietary blend of medicinal herbs that promote healing and calming.

- BioFerment 7 Complex: Proprietary blend of super antioxidants that protect the skin from stress.

Ingredient Callouts: This product is vegan, gluten-free, and cruelty-free.

What Else You Need to Know: Made with 20+ skincare ingredients, this proprietary formula delivers ultra-comfortable, longwear performance that's suitable for all skin types, including sensitive and acne-prone. Its weightless, serum-like texture seamlessly blurs and smooths for a natural, luminous finish that wears all day.

Clinical Results: In a third-party study with 185 panelists, after application:

- 96% said skin looks healthier

- 96% said skin tone looks more even

- 95% said it feels weightless on skin

Clean

This product is an Allure Best of Beauty award winner.

name: RITUEL DE FILLE - 3 Drop Weightless Serum Foundation
description:
RITUEL DE FILLE - 3 Drop Weightless Serum Foundation
Foundation that feels like skincare
3 Drop Weightless Serum Foundation works like magic for a truly transformative yet utterly natural effect. This innovative formula smooths and unifies the complexion, yet is as weightless and intuitively easy to apply as a serum. The remarkable medium-coverage formula imparts a softly diffused, subtly luminous finish.
3 Drop Weightless Serum Foundation is the first product to market in any category, including skincare, to contain the truly innovative and sustainable new active carotenoid ingredient: fermented phytoene. This is the first pure phytoene ever extracted, and this ingredient offers both remarkable short-term and long-term benefits.
Finish: Buildable medium coverage in a glowy natural finish
Texture: Lightweight oil; never sticky, never greasy, never drying
Aroma: Fragrance-free and made without any essential oils. You may notice the subtle scents of jojoba and marula oils.
Shade Description:
Potion #100 - Very fair shade for soft rose undertones
Potion #105 - Very fair shade for neutral to olive undertones

How to Use: It only takes 3 drops of this magic potion to transform your skin and create a glowy natural finish.
Shake well. Press the soft underside of the bottle to dispense onto fingertips. Apply gently to the face.
Tip: 3 drops achieves medium coverage. If desired, use fewer for lighter coverage, more for fuller coverage.
For best results, apply after Thorn Oil Priming Facial Elixir.
INGREDIENTS: Simmondsia Chinensis (Jojoba) Seed Oil*, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Sclerocarya Birrea (Marula) Seed Oil*, Jojoba Esters, Tapioca Starch, Hydrogenated Ethylhexyl Olivate, Quaternium-90 Sepiolite, Quaternium-90 Montmorillonite, Blakeslea Trispora Mycelium Extract/C30-45 Olefin, Ricinus Communis Seed Oil, Phytosterols, Rosmarinus Officinalis (Rosemary) Leaf Extract*, Helianthus Annuus (Sunflower Seed) Oil, Tocopherol
May Contain: Iron Oxides (CI 77492, CI 77491, CI 77499), Titanium Dioxide, Coco-Caprylate/Caprate, Polyglyceryl-6 Polyricinoleate, Polyhydroxystearic Acid, Dilinoleic Acid/Butanediol Copolymer, Castor Oil/IPDI Copolymer, Disodium Stearoyl Glutamate
*Certified Organic
Leaping Bunny Cruelty Free. Vegan Formula. Made by hand in Los Angeles. Crafted in small batches by a small circle of artisans.
Made without: synthetic dyes, synthetic fragrances, parabens, PEGs, phthalates, talc, carbon black, or plastic-based glitters, and we take great care in ethical sourcing.
Size: Net Wt. 1.0 fl oz / 30 ml

name: Double Wear Stay-in-Place Foundation
description:
Flawless, full-of-life matte. 36-hour color-true wear. Oil control plus hydration. Available in 57 true-to-skin shades.

Redefine longwear with a foundation designed to do more. This buildable, breathable formula delivers medium to full coverage with a lightweight, fluid texture that blends seamlessly into skin. The finish is dimensional and natural matte, never flat, never heavy, and never dry.

Performance That Lasts
36-Hour Color-True Wear
Weatherproof, gym-proof, transfer-resistant and waterproof. Resists sweat, heat, and humidity while maintaining a fresh, just-applied look all day and night.

Buildable, Breathable Coverage
Customizable medium to full coverage smooths uneven tone, blurs pores, and conceals imperfections without caking, streaking, or settling into fine lines. The flexible formula moves with skin for comfortable wear.

Advanced Oil Control + Hydration
Provides immediate hydration while delivering 36-hour oil control. Helps reduce excess oil production in just four weeks and supports moisture balance for up to 72 hours. Skin feels balanced, not tight or dry.

Shades, Same True-to-Skin Match
A comprehensive shade range designed to match real skin tones. Original shades remain unchanged for your trusted match, now enhanced with refined pigments for added dimension and vibrancy.

Skin Benefits
Suitable for all skin types, including sensitive and acne-prone skin.
Oil-free. Non-comedogenic. Dermatologist-tested. Ophthalmologist-tested.
Won't clog pores or cause breakouts.
With continued use, skin appears smoother and more even, with reduced visible pores and improved tone clarity.

Key Ingredients
Polymer Mesh Matrix Technology
A breathable polymer system that flexes with facial movement while color-treated micro-pigments help lock in shade accuracy for up to 36 hours.

Double Balancing Complex featuring AlgaNiacin™
A targeted blend designed to support oil control and hydration balance.

Glycerin + Hyaluronic Acid deliver immediate moisture and help maintain hydration over time.
Niacinamide helps even skin tone and visibly reduce the appearance of dark spots in as little as eight weeks.
Brown Algae Extract helps reduce excess oil production over time.

Coverage and Finish
Coverage: Buildable Medium to Full
Finish: Dimensional, Natural Matte
Skin Type: All Skin Types
Texture: Lightweight, Fluid
Benefits: Waterproof, Sweat-Resistant, Transfer-Resistant

How to Apply:
A reusable pump (sold separately) is available for controlled dispensing. Some customers prefer applying directly from the bottle.

Shake well before use.
Dispense a fingertip amount, press once if using a pump.
Dot onto cheeks, forehead, chin, or areas needing more coverage.
Blend outward using fingertips, a sponge, or a brush.
Build to full coverage as needed in thin layers, allowing each layer to set before applying more.
For a natural-skin finish, gently press product into skin with fingertips.

1-oz.

name: RITUEL DE FILLE - 3 Drop Weightless Serum Foundation
description:
RITUEL DE FILLE - 3 Drop Weightless Serum Foundation
Foundation that feels like skincare
3 Drop Weightless Serum Foundation works like magic for a truly transformative yet utterly natural effect. This innovative formula smooths and unifies the complexion, yet is as weightless and intuitively easy to apply as a serum. Is perfectly smooth skin on the face and body possible? Inspired by the beauty of runway models, Dior's elite cosmetics Creative Director, Peter Philips, developed a foundation. The concept is simple: to create a deeply rested look, as if you've just had a relaxing massage. This product allows you to control the color intensity, from light and weightless to full coverage. It forms an invisible mesh on the skin, ensuring exceptional makeup endurance even under extreme conditions.


Features of Christian Dior Backstage Face & Body Foundation:


- Available in a palette of 21 shades, with 6 undertones and 16 intensity variations;
- Fluid consistency;
- "Second skin" effect;
- Even distribution without blotching or creating a mask-like effect;
- Lightweight coverage that doesn't dry out the skin or clog pores;
- Maintains perfect condition in water, during workouts, and in high humidity;
- Enhances the natural radiance and beauty of the face;
- Layers well;
- Conceals imperfections;
- Doesn't highlight flakiness or settle into fine lines;
- Leaves the skin silky smooth and incredibly fresh.

Light coverage: apply with fingertips, gently patting the texture into the skin. Medium coverage: apply 2 layers of the foundation using the brush, working from the center to the edges of the face. Full-coverage: apply 3 layers of the foundation in circular motions.

2 for medium tones

4 for deeper tones.

description:
What It Is:
24H full-coverage serum foundation instantly perfects with a matte finish, plus visibly improves skin with 3 serum technology. Dermatologist tested.

What It Does:

24-hour, oil-free foundation with SPF delivers full coverage and a matte finish.
Combines the long-wearing coverage of a foundation with the transforming power of a serum to help visibly improve skin instantly and over time.
Built with 3 serum technology, a powerhouse blend of good-for-skin ingredients: Clinique's dark spot-fighting molecule UP302+, vitamin C, salicylic acid, and hyaluronic acid.
Clinically proven to leave bare skin looking even bettersmoother and more even.
Best foundation for hyperpigmentation.
Foundation with SPF 25 mineral sunscreens helps protect skin from the look of discoloration.

Combination Oily, Oily

For best results, apply after moisturizer.
Start with just a half-pump; this formula is so concentrated, a little goes a long way.
We recommend our Clinique Buff Brush for the most flawless finish, but use your preferred technique.
Apply a small amount of foundation where you need coverage the most and blend from there. You can then add more foundation for additional coverage.

A silky, lightweight foundation that blurs and smooths skin instantly for a natural glow finish with medium, buildable coverage. Designed to hydrate and last 24 hours, it delivers a luminous complexion that looks effortlessly radiant.

For a seamless, airbrushed finish, apply foundation to the center of your face and blend outward with a foundation brush. For a glowing, dewy effect, use a damp makeup sponge. Build coverage by layering as needed for a flawless, natural look.

name: Re-Nutriv Ultra Radiance Liquid Foundation SPF 20
description:
What It Is:
A luxurious liquid makeup infused with the radiant power of Peridot, with medium to full coverage, lasting moisture and a flawless, jewel-like finish.

What It Does:
Release the light. Glow like a jewel with every luxurious drop of this extraordinary liquid makeup.
Captured in every bottle: the radiant power of 2 precious Peridot stones*, helping boost skin’s natural energy for renewed vibrancy**. Plus millions of micro-fine gems to help create a flawless, jewel-like finish.
Powerfully infused with Re-Nutriv’s advanced skincare technology, it leaves skin soft, supple and smooth. Skin looks more even. Imperfections and pores seem to disappear.
The silky, fluid texture infuses long lasting moisture to keep skin looking fresh and dewy. Flawless, perfected finish stays color-true. Long-wearing. Humidity-resistant.
With SPF 20, helps defend against UVA and UVB rays, helping maintain skin’s elasticity and density and prevent the appearance of lines and wrinkles.
Reveal your skin’s infinite beauty.

ENERGIZING PERIDOT STONE
Estée Lauder Research has shown this translucent green gem helps boost skin’s natural energy for renewed vibrancy and radiance.**
To add to its mysterious power, millions of micro-fine gems, including sapphires and rubies, interact with light to create delicate nuances of illumination.
Transform your skin with the look of pure light streaming through precious gems for a flawless, jewel-like radiance.
Re-Nutriv. Live a life of extraordinary beauty.
*Based on the average weight of our Peridot stones. **In vitro testing.

How To Use:
Shake well. Smooth the liquid foundation over skin. Start at center of face and blending outward.
Add a little more to build it as a full coverage foundation.

Benefits:
Look radiant: luxurious liquid foundation.

Formula Facts:
- Long-wearing
- Color-true
- Instant and lasting moisture
- Humidity-resistant
- Covers pores
- SPF 20
- Dermatologist-tested
- Non-acnegenic; won't clog pores

name: Nars Soft Matte Complete Foundation Light 2.5 Yukon 1.5 oz / 45 ml
No Makeup Makeup 4-in-1 Foundation with Brush
description:
Discover the original No Makeup Makeup Foundation: a weightless, buildable formula with a cream-balm texture that effortlessly conceals, corrects, and camouflages. Easy to wear and true to your skin color, the original minimalist foundation is back and better than ever, with shades that match all skin tones. Plus, it lasts for up to 12 hours of long-wear while feeling silky and skin-like -- never heavy or cakey!

The 4-in-1 formula conceals, corrects, camouflages, and diffuses in a single step, functioning as a color-corrector, redness-corrector, concealer, and foundation in one. With 13 shades developed to address a full range of skin tones, the shade-adaptive FlexShade Technology "flexes" with your skin's shade and undertones to enhance your own natural complexion, allowing your skin to breathe with its barely-there texture and color correct what you need, without concealing what you don't. The goal? Your own skin, but better -- empowering you to feel confident and beautiful all day, every day, wherever and whatever you're doing.

In a consumer perception survey, participants agreed after one application:

-- 96% agreed foundation feels weightless
-- 96% agreed foundation gives a skin-like finish
-- 96% agreed foundation gave a no makeup, makeup finish
-- 96% agreed foundation matches their skin tone

No Makeup Makeup Foundation is formulated without soy, nuts, gluten, fragrance, and sulfates.

How do I use it: Using a light touch, sweep the surface of the foundation with the No Makeup Makeup Foundation Brush two or three times. A little is all you need. You should barely see any foundation on the tips of the bristles. Blend and buff in circular motions all over face for your own flawless finish. You can also use the sponge located in the dual chamber to build more coverage or to cover imperfections.

When used daily, provides approximately a three to four-month supply of foundation.

From No Makeup Makeup.

Includes 0.2-oz No Makeup Makeup Foundation in choice of shade, No Makeup Makeup Foundation Brush, and sponge applicator

name: Estée Lauder™ Double Wear Stay In Place Longwear Matte Foundation
description:
The new flawless. The new full-of-life matte. This buildable, breathable long-wear foundation is made for more. 36-hour color-true wear. Balances skin with oil control and hydration. With 57 shades, one made for you. Because you inspired us to rethink performance, we reimagined Double Wear for today. The New Double Wear is everything you love about the original, now with even better makeup and skincare benefits, so it’s truly made for more.

PROVEN RESULTS:
More Buildable + Breathable. Lightweight, more fluid texture. Medium to full coverage. Dimensional, full-of-life, never-flat matte finish.
More Longwearing. 36 hours of color-true wear. Weatherproof. Gym-proof. Transfer-proof, waterproof foundation.
More Your Shade. 57 shades. One made for you. We kept all our original shades for the same true-to-skin match—now with enhanced pigments in a more dimensional finish.
More Oil Control. Balances skin with 36-hour oil control and immediate hydration. Reduces skin's oil production in just 4 weeks. Maintains skin's moisture level for 72 hours.
More To Love Non-drying. Unifies uneven skin tone and covers imperfections. Reduces the look of pores. Non-fading, non-poring, non-caking, non-streaking, and it won’t settle into lines. This waterproof foundation is also sweat-, heat-, and humidity-resistant.

SAME TRUE-TO-SKIN MATCH, NOW EVEN BETTER. If you’re already a Double Wear fan, count on the same true-to-skin match in an even better formula. However, as with any new formula, we recommend getting re-shade-matched, as there may be an even better match for you now.

Some customers prefer to use the product straight from the bottle. For those who prefer extra control, we offer a reusable pump.

How To Use:
SHAKE: Then dispense a fingertip amount—press once if you are using the pump.
DOT: Apply to the areas you want most coverage (like cheeks, forehead, and chin).
BLEND: With fingertips, sponge, or brush, from the center of your face outward.
REPEAT: Build to full coverage as needed. Let each layer dry before applying more. Press in with fingertips for a natural-skin finish.

FEATURED INGREDIENTS:
Polymer Mesh Matrix Technology: A breathable polymer system that moves with you and color-treated micro-pigments that help lock in your shade for 36-hour color-true wear.
Double Balancing Complex featuring AlgaNiacin™ Balances skin with hydration and reduced oil production.
Glycerin and Hyaluronic Acid: This blend delivers immediate moisture and helps maintain moisture levels over time.
Niacinamide: Helps reduce sebum production over time. A key ingredient in our AlgaNiacin™ blend.
Brown Algae Extract: Helps reduce oil production over time. A key ingredient in our AlgaNiacin™ blend is in this noncomedogenic foundation.

For all skin types
Safe for sensitive skin and acne-prone skin
Dermatologist tested

description:
Shop Women's Haus Labs By Lady Gaga Cream White Size Various Foundation at a discounted price at Poshmark. Description: ✅NEW IN BOX ✅

🌷HAUS LABS 🌷

🌟 TRICLONE SKIN TECH MEDIUM COVERAGE FOUNDATION🌟


Fill Weight: 30 ml / 1 fl oz


The Deep Dive

Finally, a clean foundation for makeup lovers. Infused with 20+ skincare ingredients, this proprietary formula delivers ultra comfortable, longwear performance without compromising your skin. Its weightless, serum-like texture seamlessly blurs and smooths for a natural, luminous finish that wears all day. No slipping or caking. Foundation never felt (or looked) so good.
Using the science of color theory, we obsessively formulated the perfect spectrum of 51 shades across 6 families based on your skin’s depth and undertones. Our shade numbering system (590-000) is based on the pigment load by shade – the higher the number, the higher the pigment load and deeper the shade.


Undertones:

Rooted in artistry, our undertone system is based on a true color wheel, which may be different from what you are used to. Using this artistry method, our undertones are defined as:

Warm: Pink, rosy or peach tones – When you get warm, your skin gets flushed and red. The veins in your wrist are primarily blue or purple.

Cool: Yellow, golden or olive tones – Your skin tans easily after spending time in the sun. The veins in your wrist are primarily green.

Neutral: Balance of golden + rosy tones – The veins in your wrist are a mix of blue +green

description:
Finish: Matte
Coverage: Full, buildable

WHAT IT IS
Skin Types: Combination Oily, Oily

24-hour full-coverage foundation instantly perfects with a matte finish, plus visibly improves skin with 3 serum technology. 86% skincare formula.*

Dermatologist tested. Ophthalmologist tested. Allergy tested. 100% fragrance-free.

*14% makeup ingredients.

RESULTS
High-Performance Results
• 91% say skin immediately looks perfected.*
• 91% say color stays true throughout the day.*
• 92% say bare skin looks more radiant.**
• 91% see reduced imperfections on bare skin—like dark spots, discolorations, age spots, and blemish marks.**
• 90% say bare skin looks smoother and more even-toned.**
*Consumer testing on 227 women after using product for 1 week.
**Consumer testing on 221 women after using product for 8 weeks.

PRODUCT DETAILS
24-hour foundation infused with skincare.

Coverage
24-hour, oil-free foundation with SPF delivers full coverage and a matte finish.

Formula
Combines the long-wearing coverage of a foundation with the transforming power of a serum to help visibly improve skin instantly and over time. It’s long-wear with skincare.

3 Serum Technology
• Our serum foundation is built with 3 serum technology, a powerhouse blend of good-for-skin ingredients: Clinique’s dark spot-fighting molecule UP302+, vitamin C, salicylic acid, and hyaluronic acid.
• Clinically proven to leave bare skin looking even better—smoother and more even.
• Even Better Clinical™ Serum Foundation SPF 25 is one of Clinique’s best foundations for hyperpigmentation.

Sun Protection
Foundation with SPF 25 mineral sunscreens helps protect skin from the look of discoloration.

42 Shades
In 42 shades and a non-oxidizing formula for a perfect match that lasts throughout the day.

KEY INGREDIENTS
UP302 + Vitamin C
Help visibly reduce the look of dark spots and uneven skin tone.

Salicylic acid
Helps re-texturize skin.

Hyaluronic acid
Helps plump up skin for a more youthful look.

SPF 25 mineral sunscreen
Liquid foundation with SPF helps protect skin from future discoloration.

FORMULA FACTS
Clinical Expertise
• Dermatologist tested
• Ophthalmologist tested
• Allergy tested
• Fragrance-free

Great to Know
• 24-hour color-true wear
• 24-hour defense against caking, settling/creasing, poring, and streaking
• Sweat and humidity resistant
• Waterproof
• Mineral sunscreen
• Antioxidant protection helps protect skin from effects of blue light
• Oil-free
• Non-acnegenic

Free Of
• Fragrance
• Parabens
• Phthalates
• Oil
• Synthetic colors
• Sodium lauryl sulfate
• Sodium laureth sulfate

HOW TO USE
• For best results, apply foundation after moisturizer.
• Start with just a half-pump; this formula is so concentrated, a little goes a long way.
• We recommend our Clinique Buff Brush for the most flawless finish, but use your preferred technique.
• Apply a small amount of foundation where you need coverage the most and blend from there. You can then add more foundation for additional coverage.

How to Open
• Twist the cap in a clockwise motion, then push it upwards—it will pop off easily.
• It’s specially designed so it won’t come loose in transit or as you remove it from the box.

More Sustainable Packaging
• Every glass bottle of Even Better Clinical Serum Foundation can be recycled.
• Remove the cap and pump, rinse the glass bottle, and place in a recycling bin.

name: No Makeup Makeup Foundation
description: Inside this cool ’80s-esque compact is a brilliant multipurpose balm that works as a concealer, color-corrector, and foundation in one. The creamy formula is infused with moisturizing vitamin E and jojoba oil, so it melts into skin and feels nourishing but not heavy or cakey. Sweep it on with a foundation brush (or the included sponge)—you need only the smallest amount—and buff it out; it blurs imperfections and leaves you with a soft, seamless finish: not too heavy, not too made-up, just the best possible version of your skin. Porcelain: The lightest shade, for palest skin. For porcelain skin tones with neutral undertones. Fair: For fair skin tones with light cool neutral undertones. Light: For light skin tones with neutral undertones. Light Medium: For light-medium skin tones with neutral warm undertones. Medium: For medium skin tones with neutral olive undertones. name: Airbrush Flawless Foundation
description:
A 3D matte not flat, blurring foundation that delivers up to 24 hours of full coverage and shine control.This light-as-air, 7-in-1 foundation targets blemishes, redness, visible pores, fine lines, hyperpigmentation, uneven skin, and dark circles all in one pump! Powered by Powder Blur AIRTech™ for intensified smoothing, blurring, and retexturizing, it's Charlotte's Airbrush Powder effect, bottled!
 
BENEFITS

BIOMIMETIC SECOND-SKIN TECH TM: ENHANCES LONG-LASTING WEAR OF FOUNDATION FOR A WATERPROOF, TRANSFER-PROOF, LIFE-PROOF COVERAGE!
POWDER BLUR AIRTECH TM: LIGHT DIFUSSING POWDERS SMOOTH, BLUR, RETEXTURIZING EFFECT THAT INSTANTLY MINIMIZES THE APPERANCE OF FINE LINES, WRINKLES, PORES & SHINE
PHYTOYOUTH ESSENCE TM: TARGETS VISIBLE SIGNS OF AGING, INCLUDING FINE LINES, HYPERPIGMENTATION, AND UNEVEN SKIN TEXTURE

 
HOW TO USE

PREP: Before applying Airbrush Flawless Foundation, always prime with Charlotte’s Magic Cream (sold separately)! The miracle moisturizer instantly hydrates, smooths, and plumps the look of skin, creating the perfect canvas for makeup!
PERFECT: Apply Airbrush Flawless Foundation using the Hollywood Complexion Brush (sold separately), buffing it in from the center of your face outwards for a flawless, airbrushed finish!
TILBURY TIP: Use half a pump for a clean girl finish. Use one pump for full coverage.


INGREDIENTS

BIOMIMETIC SECOND-SKIN TECH TM: ENHANCES LONG-LASTING WEAR OF FOUNDATION FOR A WATERPROOF, TRANSFER-PROOF, LIFE-PROOF COVERAGE!
POWDER BLUR AIRTECH TM: LIGHT DIFUSSING POWDERS SMOOTH, BLUR, RETEXTURIZING EFFECT THAT INSTANTLY MINIMIZES THE APPERANCE OF FINE LINES, WRINKLES, PORES & SHINE

A viral sensation in Japan, we think Cherubs the world over will love TIRTIR’s multi-award-winning Mask Fit Red Cushion foundation! This TIRTIR cushion foundation is renowned for its moisturising, high-coverage, and long-lasting formula, which uniquely incorporates air-layered powder to reduce excess facial oil and ensure a smooth, perfect-looking finish. It is also enriched with Niacinamide and Propolis Extract, which promote a brighter, more even skin tone, while collagen-boosting Adenosine works to minimise the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles. Leaving skin with a flawless semi-matte finish that lasts for 72 hours without touch-ups, it has the stamina to keep up with even the busiest Cherubs.
It’s Skin Cupid approved because…
…this TikTok-famous foundation not only offers coverage but nourishes and hydrates, helping your skin to glow with or without makeup.
At a glance:

name: Airbrush Flawless Foundation
description:
A 3D matte not flat, blurring foundation that delivers up to 24 hours of full coverage and shine control.This light-as-air, 7-in-1 foundation targets blemishes, redness, visible pores, fine lines, hyperpigmentation, uneven skin, and dark circles all in one pump! Powered by Powder Blur AIRTech™ for intensified smoothing, blurring, and retexturizing, it's Charlotte's Airbrush Powder effect, bottled!
 
BENEFITS

BIOMIMETIC SECOND-SKIN TECH TM: ENHANCES LONG-LASTING WEAR OF FOUNDATION FOR A WATERPROOF, TRANSFER-PROOF, LIFE-PROOF COVERAGE!
POWDER BLUR AIRTECH TM: LIGHT DIFUSSING POWDERS SMOOTH, BLUR, RETEXTURIZING EFFECT THAT INSTANTLY MINIMIZES THE APPERANCE OF FINE LINES, WRINKLES, PORES & SHINE
PHYTOYOUTH ESSENCE TM: TARGETS VISIBLE SIGNS OF AGING, INCLUDING FINE LINES, HYPERPIGMENTATION, AND UNEVEN SKIN TEXTURE

 
HOW TO USE

PREP: Before applying Airbrush Flawless Foundation, always prime with Charlotte’s Magic Cream (sold separately)! The miracle moisturizer instantly hydrates, smooths, and plumps the look of skin, creating the perfect canvas for makeup!
PERFECT: Apply Airbrush Flawless Foundation using the Hollywood Complexion Brush (sold separately), buffing it in from the center of your face outwards for a flawless, airbrushed finish!
TILBURY TIP: Use half a pump for a clean girl finish. Use one pump for full coverage.


INGREDIENTS

BIOMIMETIC SECOND-SKIN TECH TM: ENHANCES LONG-LASTING WEAR OF FOUNDATION FOR A WATERPROOF, TRANSFER-PROOF, LIFE-PROOF COVERAGE!
POWDER BLUR AIRTECH TM: LIGHT DIFUSSING POWDERS SMOOTH, BLUR, RETEXTURIZING EFFECT THAT INSTANTLY MINIMIZES THE APPERANCE OF FINE LINES, WRINKLES, PORES & SHINE

description:
Achieve Flawless, Long-Lasting Coverage
Discover the TIRTIR Mask Fit Red Cushion, a hydrating cushion foundation designed to deliver full coverage with a natural, semi-matte finish. This lightweight formula blends seamlessly, concealing imperfections and evening skin tone while keeping your skin nourished and comfortable all day.
Key Features and Benefits


Full-Coverage Perfection – Smooths and evens skin tone, blurs pores, and conceals blemishes effortlessly.


Hydrating Formula – Packed with hyaluronic acid and botanical extracts to keep skin moisturized and healthy.


Lightweight Comfort – Breathable, non-cakey texture suitable for sensitive and acne-prone skin.


Long-Wear Performance – Provides up to 72 hours of flawless, fade-resistant coverage.


Why Choose TIRTIR Mask Fit Red Cushion?
72-hour flawless coverage, 40 inclusive shades, and hydration in one. Blurs pores, evens tone, and conceals effortlessly with a lightweight, dermatologist-tested formula perfect for sensitive skin. Trusted by experts, made for everyone.

name: Blurring Ceramide Cream Foundation
description:
Blurring Ceramide Cream Foundation 
This product is: An award winning, skin care-infused cream foundation with flexible coverage and a blurring, natural-radiant skin finish.
Good for: All Skin types. Hypoallergenic & gluten free.
Why we love it: MOB Beauty Blurring Ceramide Cream Foundation is a skincare powered cream foundation and concealer hybrid that blurs the skin with a multi-dimensional mineral technology that gives a radiant light bounce and natural skin finish.   
Ceramide 2 holds moisture in the skin and repairs the skin barrier during wear, and a small molecule hyaluronic acid visibly plumps and hydrates leaving skin looking supple, nourished, and refreshed. Avocado oil gives the formula creamy blendability while natural sugar polymers offers flexible comfort, skin adhesion, and long wear. Anti-inflammatories Bisabolol and Phytosphingosine calm the skin and soothe redness, and the unique waterless formula stays color true all day.
The Blurring Ceramide Cream Foundation compact is sustainably designed with 90% post - consumer recycled fiber and can be recycled or simply thrown away after the eyeshadow pan is removed because the compact is biodegradable! The foundation pan is made with 100% post - consumer recycled PET and can be popped out of the compact and easily snapped into MOB’s endlessly refillable and infinitely customizable palettes allowing you to build your own customizable, convenient, all in one palette.
 MOB Beauty Blurring Ceramide Cream Foundation is available in 26 shades:

name: Glamour Crème™ Ultra HD Foundation Samples
description:
Glamour Crème™ Ultra HD Foundation Sample (1 Gram)
Find your best shade - without the guesswork.
With over 80 professional shades, finding the right match can feel overwhelming. That’s why we offer Glamour Crème™ sample sizes, so you can try shades at home, on your own skin, in your own lighting before committing to a full size.
For even faster results, take our quick 2-question Shade Match Quiz to narrow your options to the shades most likely to match.
Try them, compare them, and choose the one that looks best on your skin.

Why makeup artists trust Glamour Crème™
Graftobian’s Ultra HD Glamour Crème™ Foundation is trusted by professional makeup artists in film, television, bridal, theater, and photography.
It delivers:
• High-pigment coverage that helps reduce the appearance of redness, discoloration, blemishes, and other visible skin concerns• A smooth, skin-like finish that never looks heavy or cakey• Ultra-fine pigments designed for HD cameras, harsh lighting, and everyday wear• A silky formula that blends beautifully and feels comfortable on the skin
The result is professional HD coverage that looks smooth, natural, and camera-ready.

A little goes a long way
Glamour Crème™ is made with high-performance pigments, so you need very little product for beautiful coverage.
Even a small sample lets you:
• Test the shade on your skin• See how it looks in natural and indoor light• Experience the formula’s finish, blendability, and coverage

Not sure which shade to try?
Take our Shade Match Quiz to quickly narrow down the shades most likely to match your skin depth and undertone.
Then order a few samples to test at home with more confidence.

How to apply
For natural everyday coverageApply a small amount with a foundation brush or sponge, then set with powder.
For fuller HD coverageBuild gradually in areas with redness, uneven tone, or other visible skin concerns for more polished, studio-style coverage.

About our foundation samples
This 1-gram sample gives you enough product to test the shade and experience the formula before purchasing a full-size foundation.
Because screens can display color differently, digital swatches may not perfectly represent the actual shade. Samples let you see the color on your own skin before you buy.
✔ Take the Shade Match Quiz✔ Try a few samples at home✔ Find your best shade with confidence and get the full size

name: Studio Radiance Serum-Powered Foundation
description:
A buildable, weightless, 24-hour hydrating foundation that smooths texture, evens tone, and blurs the look of pores.

Get into serum-powered radiance. Meet the serum-powered foundation that fuses MAC's expertise of skin tones with the science of skincare. This innovation delivers hydration for plumper, smoother and more radiant skin. MAC's breakthrough foundation also delivers skin that's more hydrated and healthier-looking over time with all-day radiance. It's powered by 33 skincare ingredients including a 10% hyaluronic acid solution, locking in moisture beneath the skin's surface. It's also infused with a cocktail of powerful skin-caring superfoods, including olive and jojoba oils to condition skin for a healthier-looking glow, plus antioxidants to protect skin from pollution and blue light.

Studio Radiance Serum-Powered Foundation features 24-hour hydration and medium buildable, smoothing coverage that instantly evens out your complexion. This lightweight foundation also blurs the appearance of pores, skin redness, dark spots, and dry fine lines. Achieve a customized glow with this foundation's Artist-Curated Radiance Blend, made from silver and gold pearlescent particles specifically crafted to complement unique undertones of light and rich skin. Available in naturally radiant shades for all. The recyclable glass foundation bottle was crafted with sustainability in mind, featuring a cap made with 30% PCR.

Key Claims and Benefits:

Won't cake, crease, settle, or cause breakouts
Naturally radiant shades
33 skincare ingredients including a 10% hyaluronic acid solution
12-hour radiant long wear
Hydrates immediately and over time
Strengthens the skin barrier. Protects against pollution
Water-, sweat-, humidity-, and transfer-resistant
Dermatologist tested and non-comedogenic
Safe for sensitive skin

How to Use:
Apply onto the face with a 170S Brush (sold separately), fingers, or a makeup sponge. Blend or build to desired coverage and look.

1-oz.

name: No Makeup Makeup Foundation, Weightless Cream-Balm Formula Conceals, Corrects And Camouflages With Skin-Tone Adaptive Flexshade Technology, Buildable, Long-Lasting, Cruelty-Free, Vegan, Fair
description:
ABOUT THE PRODUCT: Discover The Original No Makeup Makeup Foundation - a weightless, buildable, cream-balm formula that corrects, conceals and camouflages with a natural, skin-first finish. Our skin-tone adaptive FlexShade Technology “flexes” to your skin’s shade and undertones for a seamless match, enhancing your own natural complexion. Shade Porcelain is for very fair skin with neutral ivory tones. Our lightest shade, for palest skin. Use this shade if you normally wear Porcelain or Alabaster.
WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT: This unique 4-in-1 formula conceals, corrects, camouflages, and diffuses in a single-step, functioning as color-corrector, redness-corrector, concealer, and foundation in one. Designed for you to apply-and-go in seconds with built-in mistake-proof functionality.
HOW TO USE: Lightly sweep the surface of the foundation with our Perfect Foundation Brush. A little is all you need. Build coverage as needed by lightly dabbing your brush on the foundation and applying in light sweeping circles. You can also use the convenient application sponge located in the dual chamber to build more coverage or cover imperfections. Blend and buff in circular motions all over face for a flawless finish.
SKIN-LOVING INGREDIENTS: Formulated with Jojoba Oil and Vitamin E to help moisturize and nurture the skin. This multitasking foundation is clinically tested by dermatologists to ensure it’s gentle and safe for even the most sensitive skin types. Cruelty-free, vegan, fragrance- and allergen-free, and formulated without harsh ingredients.
ABOUT US: No Makeup Makeup is built on a simple belief: Less is Best. We create tech-led beauty essentials that adapt to you—your skin tone, your chemistry, your life. Powered by proprietary, skin-responsive innovations, our formulas flex & adjust for seamless, natural results that never look or feel like makeup. Every product is thoughtfully designed to do more with less, simplifying your routine while enhancing what’s already yours. Effortless. Intelligent. Beauty that meets you where you are.

name: Blurring Ceramide Cream Foundation
description:
About MOB Beauty Blurring Ceramide Cream Foundation

The skincare-packed MOB Beauty Blurring Ceramide Cream Foundation is a foundation and concealer hybrid that blurs and diffuses the skin with multi-dimensional mineral technology. Ceramide 2 holds moisture in the skin and repairs the skin barrier while award-winning, small-molecule hyaluronic acid visibly plumps with hydration. A powerful cocktail of anti-inflammatories and antioxidants soothes and protects, and its unique waterless formula keeps its color all day. Available in 4 undertones, enhance your skin tone with lasting, flexible coverage and a natural, radiant finish.

Why It's Special

A foundation and concealer hybrid made with a complex blend of multi-dimensional pigments that deliver a diffused blur and a natural-radiant light bounce
Ceramide 2, sourced from Korea, decreases epidermal water loss while protecting the skin’s barrier
Award-winning, small-molecule hyaluronic acid visibly plumps and hydrates, leaving skin supple, nourished, and refreshed
Avocado oil gives the formula creamy blendability while natural sugar polymers offer flexible comfort, skin adhesion, and long wear
Anti-inflammatories bisabolol and phytosphingosine calm the skin and soothe redness
Unique waterless formula easily builds to full coverage and doesn’t change color during wear
Outer box and compact are made with post-consumer recycled materials and are biodegradable thus can be recycled or simply discarded after use. Product pan refill can be popped out and should be recycled when empty. Create your own personalized palette by popping the pan out of the compact and into MOB's endlessly refillable and customizable palettes.

How to Use

Apply with fingers, brush, or sponge to the face and under eye area as a foundation and/or concealer and build to your desired coverage.

Other Details

Vegan

name: Blurring Ceramide Cream Foundation
description:
About MOB Beauty Blurring Ceramide Cream Foundation

The skincare-packed MOB Beauty Blurring Ceramide Cream Foundation is a foundation and concealer hybrid that blurs and diffuses the skin with multi-dimensional mineral technology. Ceramide 2 holds moisture in the skin and repairs the skin barrier while award-winning, small-molecule hyaluronic acid visibly plumps with hydration. A powerful cocktail of anti-inflammatories and antioxidants soothes and protects, and its unique waterless formula keeps its color all day. Available in 4 undertones, enhance your skin tone with lasting, flexible coverage and a natural, radiant finish.

Why It's Special

A foundation and concealer hybrid made with a complex blend of multi-dimensional pigments that deliver a diffused blur and a natural-radiant light bounce
Ceramide 2, sourced from Korea, decreases epidermal water loss while protecting the skin’s barrier
Award-winning, small-molecule hyaluronic acid visibly plumps and hydrates, leaving skin supple, nourished, and refreshed
Avocado oil gives the formula creamy blendability while natural sugar polymers offer flexible comfort, skin adhesion, and long wear
Anti-inflammatories bisabolol and phytosphingosine calm the skin and soothe redness
Unique waterless formula easily builds to full coverage and doesn’t change color during wear
Outer box and compact are made with post-consumer recycled materials and are biodegradable thus can be recycled or simply discarded after use. Product pan refill can be popped out and should be recycled when empty. Create your own personalized palette by popping the pan out of the compact and into MOB's endlessly refillable and customizable palettes.

How to Use

Apply with fingers, brush, or sponge to the face and under eye area as a foundation and/or concealer and build to your desired coverage.

Other Details

Awarded Cosmopolitan’s Best Clean Foundation of 2024
Size: 3.5 g
Vegan
Cruelty-free
Paraben-free
Silicone-free
Phthalates-free
Gluten-free
Leaping Bunny and PETA certified
Free of alcohol, gluten, and soy

name: Cover Creme Foundation SPF 30
description:
#1 Dermatologist Recommended Coverage Brand Dermablend brings you its best-selling full coverage foundation, Cover Crème with broad spectrum SPF 30. This cream foundation is formulated for all skin types, provides all-day hydration, and is now proven to repair & strengthen the skin barrier. Featuring a high concentration of high-performance pigments, this creamy texture is never cakey or masky, providing a natural yet flawless look. Foundation glides on evenly to leave skin feeling fresh, soft and smooth. This multi-use formula can be used as a foundation, a cream concealer or a cream contour. Cover Crème is a makeup artists' go-to foundation to conceal skin concerns such as hyperpigmentation, scars, acne scars, birthmarks, vitiligo, and uneven skin tone. Provides flawless coverage for up to 16 hours of consistent smudge and transfer-resistant wear when set with Dermablend Setting Powder. Cruelty-free.

Product Benefits:

Repairs & strengthens the skin barrier

Creamy texture, never cakey or masky
Smudge and transfer-resistant wear for up to 16 hours when set with Dermablend Setting Powder

name: Phyto-blanc Le Cushion
description: The technology of the new-generation Phyto-Blanc Complex in a portable cushion compact foundation. Immediately, skin feels moisturized and smooth. The complexion looks fresh, luminous and even. Blemishes appear blurred and the pores look minimized. Day after day, skin looks clearer, more luminous and dark spots are diminished.    Patented Phyto-Blanc Complex: visibly brightens and evens the complexion; enhances radiance  Peach blossom extract: boosts the complexion’s radiance  Buckwheat seed extract: antioxidant properties and protects the skin against external aggressors (pollution, fine particles, free radicals)  Vitamin E derivative: anti-free radical and anti-oxidant support  Sugar of vegetable origin: promotes ongoing hydration  Pro-vitamin B5: soothes and helps maintain skin hydration   Skin feels lastingly moisturized and protected on a daily basis due to its powerful urban protection (anti-pollution and anti-free radicals).  Its light, melt-in texture offers a feeling of freshness upon application.  The fine and undetectable formula gives a bare-skin effect and a natural glowing finish.  It is sweat and rub-resistant, as well as long-lasting.    How to use: Start by using the included cushion sponge applicator to take a small amount of the formula, then use a press and roll motion across the entire face. Continue to use this method and add additional product until the desired result is obtained.  This gradual application technique (pressing and rolling to a greater or lesser degree) allows you to create a tailor-made natural glow and adjust the coverage as desired and needed. Reapply during the day if desired. Phyto-Blanc skincare routine is an ideal pairing with the Phyto-Blanc foundation to further enhance the benefits. Sponge care: wash regularly with soap or a mild shampoo and water. Rinse well. Allow to air dry.

name: Double Wear Stay-In-Place Longwear Matte Foundation
description:
WHAT IT IS
The long-wear foundation that’s made for more. Flawless, full-of-life matte. 36-hour color-true wear. Oil-control + hydration. In 57 shades.

WHAT IT DOES
The new flawless. The new full-of-life matte. This buildable, breathable longwear foundation is made for more. 36-hour color-true wear. Balances skin with oil control and hydration. 57 shades—one made for you.

Because you inspired us to rethink performance, we reimagined Double Wear for today. The New Double Wear is everything you love about the original, now with even better makeup and skincare benefits so it’s truly made for more.

PROVEN RESULTS
More Buildable + Breathable. Lightweight, more fluid texture. Medium to full coverage. Dimensional, full-of-life, never-flat matte finish.
More Longwearing. 36 hours of color-true wear. Weatherproof. Gym-proof. Transfer-proof, waterproof foundation.
More Your Shade. 57 shades. One made for you. We kept all our original shades for the same true-to-skin match—now with enhanced pigments in a more dimensional finish.
More Oil Control. Balances skin with 36 hour oil control and immediate hydration. Reduces skin's oil production in just 4 weeks. Maintains skin's moisture level for 72 hours.
More To Love Non-drying. Unifies uneven skintone and covers imperfections. Reduces the look of pores. Non-fading, non-poring, non-caking, non-streaking, and it won’t settle into lines. This waterproof foundation is also sweat-, heat- and humidity-resistant.

For all skin types. Safe for sensitive skin and acne-prone skin. Non-comedogenic foundation.

SAME TRUE-TO-SKIN MATCH, NOW EVEN BETTER If you’re already a Double Wear fan, count on the same true-to-skin match in an even better formula. However, as with any new formula, we recommend getting re-shade matched as there may be an even better match for you now.

Some customers prefer to use the product straight from the bottle. For those who prefer extra control, we offer a reusable pump.

FEATURED INGREDIENTS
Polymer Mesh Matrix Technology: A breathable polymer system that moves with you and color-treated micro-pigments that help lock in your shade for 36-hour color-true wear.
Double Balancing Complex featuring AlgaNiacin™ Balances skin with hydration and reduced oil production.
• Glycerin and Hyaluronic Acid: This blend delivers immediate moisture and helps maintain moisture levels over time.
• Niacinamide: Evens skin tone and reduces the appearance of dark spots in just 8 weeks. A key ingredient in our AlgaNiacin™ blend.
• Brown Algae Extract: Helps reduce oil production over time. A key ingredient in our AlgaNiacin™ blend in this noncomedogenic foundation.

HOW TO USE
SHAKE: Then dispense a fingertip amount—press once if you are using the pump.

DOT: Apply to the areas you want most coverage (like cheeks, forehead and chin).

BLEND: With fingertips, sponge or brush, from the center of your face outward.

REPEAT: Build to full coverage as needed. Let each layer dry before applying more. Press in with fingertips for a natural-skin finish.

FORMULA FACTS
• Oil-free
• Dermatologisttested
• Ophthalmologisttested
• Won't cause breakouts, won't clog pores (noncomedogenic foundation)

FREE FROM
• Animal-Derived Ingredients
• Drying Alcohol
• Oil • SLS/SLES
• Sulfite
• Synthetic Fragrance

FINISH
Dimensional, Full-Of-Life, Natural Matte Finish

COVERAGE

name: Clinique Even Better Clinical™ Serum Foundation Broad Spectrum
description:
Finish: Matte

Coverage: Full, buildable

WHAT IT IS

Skin Types: Combination Oily, Oily

24-hour full-coverage foundation instantly perfects with a matte finish, plus visibly improves skin with 3 serum technology. 86% skincare formula.*

Dermatologist tested. Ophthalmologist tested. Allergy tested. 100% fragrance free.

*14% makeup ingredients

RESULTS

High-Performance Results.

91% say skin immediately looks perfected.*
91% say color stays true throughout the day.*
92% say bare skin looks more radiant.**
91% see reduced imperfections on bare skin—like dark spots, discolorations, age spots, and blemish marks.**
90% say bare skin looks smoother and more even-toned.**

*Consumer testing on 227 women after using product for 1 week.

**Consumer testing on 221 women after using product for 8 weeks.

PRODUCT DETAILS

24-hour foundation infused with skincare.

Coverage
24-hour, oil-free foundation with SPF delivers full coverage and a matte finish.

Formula
Combines the long-wearing coverage of a foundation with the transforming power of a serum to help visibly improve skin instantly and over time. It’s long-wear with skincare.

3 Serum Technology

The serum foundation is built with 3 serum technology, a powerhouse blend of good-for-skin ingredients: Clinique’s dark spot-fighting molecule UP302+, vitamin C, salicylic acid, and hyaluronic acid.
Clinically proven to leave bare skin looking even better—smoother and more even.
Even Better Clinical™ Serum Foundation SPF 25 is one of Clinique’s best foundations for hyperpigmentation.

Sun Protection
Foundation with SPF 25 mineral sunscreens helps protect skin from the look of discoloration.

42 Shades
In 42 shades and a non-oxidizing formula for a perfect match that lasts throughout the day.

KEY INGREDIENTS

UP302 + Vitamin C
Help visibly reduce the look of dark spots and uneven skin tone.

Salicylic acid
Helps re-texturize skin.

Hyaluronic acid
Helps plump up skin for a more youthful look.

SPF 25 mineral sunscreen
Liquid foundation with SPF helps protect skin from future discoloration.

FORMULA FACTS

Clinical Expertise

Dermatologist tested
Ophthalmologist tested
Allergy tested
Fragrance free

Great to Know

24-hour color-true wear
24-hour defense against caking, settling/creasing, poring, and streaking
Sweat and humidity resistant
Waterproof
Mineral sunscreen
Antioxidant protection helps protect skin from effects of blue light
Oil-free
Non-acnegenic

Free Of

Fragrance
Parabens
Phthalates
Oil
Synthetic colors
Sodium lauryl sulfate
Sodium laureth sulfate

HOW TO USE

For best results, apply foundation after moisturizer.
Start with just a half-pump; this formula is so concentrated, a little goes a long way.
We recommend our Clinique Buff Brush for the most flawless finish, but use your preferred technique.
Apply a small amount of foundation where you need coverage the most and blend from there. You can then add more foundation for additional coverage.

How to Open

Twist the cap in a clockwise motion, then push it upwards—it will pop off easily.
It’s specially designed so it won’t come loose in transit or as you remove it from the box.

More Sustainable Packaging

Every glass bottle of Even Better Clinical Serum Foundation can be recycled.
Remove the cap and pump, rinse the glass bottle, and place in a recycling bin.

LEARN MORE

Foundation Finder

Use Virtual Try On to find your perfect match, right from your phone. Find Your Shade.

name: Luminous Silk Natural Glow Blurring Foundation
description:
Luminous Silk Foundation is a silky, lightweight foundation that instantly blurs and smooths skin, delivering medium buildable coverage, 24hr wear + hydration, and a natural glow finish. Now with 18 new shades to service a wider range of skin intensities and undertones, including olive skin tones.

The same iconic silky texture and natural glow finish is non-comedogenic, newly enhanced with Niacinamide and clinically proven to even skin tone, refine texture, and boost luminosity after 14 days. Once applied, after dry down, shade remains true-to-skin all day and is transfer resistant.

Dermatologist tested to be safe for all skin types, including sensitive and acne prone.

name: Studio Radiance Serum-Powered Foundation
description: MAC's Studio Radiance Serum-powered Foundation delivers a natural, lit-from-within glow with light-to-full, buildable coverage that helps blur the look of pores, even tone, and smooth the appearance of texture while staying weightless. The finish reads soft and luminous, keeping skin looking fresh without heavy buildup. Powered by 10% hyaluronic acid plus vitamin E, along with nourishing jojoba and olive oils, it helps lock in lasting moisture so skin feels comfortable throughout wear. The formula is designed to hold up to water, sweat, humidity, and transfer, helping color stay true without caking, creasing, or settling, and it is non-comedogenic and dermatologist-tested for sensitive skin, offered in 56 naturally radiant shades with a precise frosted glass pump.
