name: C.O. Bigelow
description:
3 Drop Weightless Serum Foundation works like magic for a truly transformative yet utterly natural effect. This innovative formula smooths and unifies the complexion, yet is as weightless and intuitively easy to apply as a serum. The remarkable medium-coverage formula imparts a softly diffused, subtly luminous finish.
3 Drop Weightless Serum Foundation is the first product to market in any category, including skincare, to contain the truly innovative and sustainable new active carotenoid ingredient: fermented phytoene. This is the first pure phytoene ever extracted, and this ingredient offers both remarkable short-term and long-term benefits. Clinical trials have shown it to protect against free radicals, brighten and smooth skin, enhance firmness and elasticity, and support the skin barrier among its many long-term benefits.Finish: Buildable medium coverage in a glowy natural finishTexture: Lightweight oil; never sticky, never greasy, never dryingAroma: Fragrance-free and made without any essential oils. You may notice the subtle scents of jojoba and marula oils.1 fl oz / 30 ml

name: Sephora Collection Best Skin Ever 16 Hour Natural Finish Liquid Foundation 37P (0.84 oz)
description: What it is: A medium-coverage foundation with a natural finish and long-wearing formula that hydrates the skin for up to 16 hours with hyaluronic acid. Coverage: Medium Finish: Natural Formulation: Liquid What Else You Need to Know: Available in a wide range of shades, Best Skin Ever foundation offers buildable coverage for your skin—from medium to full. It corrects the look of blemishes and redness and has a weightless feel. Its natural satin finish and imperceptible texture make your skin look like the best version of itself. After 28 days, the skin shows signs of improvement. The ultra-flexible, no-transfer formula features an 86 percent** skincare base and is enriched with hyaluronic acid, smoothing skin’s surface and evening out the complexion. Following application, your skin feels more moisturized and rested. Clinical Results: Clinical scoring from a clinical study on 22 people, 16 hours after application: - Stays in place without any sensations of dryness for up to 16 hours **Minimum percentage of foundation base without pigments. About the brand: As Sephora’s own brand, we flex our extensive industry knowledge to create paycheck-friendly products that perform on par with more spendy ones. So whether you’re looking for a ride-or-die eyeliner or a clean skincare routine that doesn’t require a small investment, rest assured: Sephora Collection will wow you and your wallet.

name: Very Valentino 24 Hour Wear Liquid Foundation
description:
Very Light, Very Lasting, Very Valentino Foundation. This semi-matte finish perfectly balances three foundation dreams: buildable coverage, breathable and lightweight texture, and long-lasting 24-hour wear. Available in 40 shades, made for all skin tones.

Very Valentino foundation features exclusive Light-Lasting™ Technology to deliver buildable, medium coverage with a comfortable, breathable feel. Formulated with an extra-light powder that can absorb up to 3 times its own weight, the formula allows for a perfect, hydrated, semi-matte foundation finish that lasts all day long.

Available in 40 inclusive shades, made for all skintones. The foundation range was developed in partnership with extensive research on 5,000 women in eight countries across every continent. To ensure perfect coverage and feel, our formula is tailored to each skintone, ensuring the most perfect finish from the lightest to deepest foundation shade.

Benefits

Semi-Matte Finish
24 hour-wear
Buildable Coverage
Lightweight and breathable
Transfer-resistant
Comfortable feel
SPF 26

name: Lip care balm
description:
THE CREATION
 Luminous matte skincare foundation was conceived by Gregoris Pyrpylis, creative director of Hermès Beauty, to deliver the perfect balance of high-performance make-up, effective skincare and a natural look.
 It evens out the skin instantly, blurring imperfections. Its 16-hour* long-lasting hold and its medium, buildable coverage enhance and restore the complexion's radiance. Over time, the skin is moisturized and regains its elasticity, while fine lines are visibly smoothed.
 
 THE MAKE-UP RESULT
 With its luminous matte finish and fluid texture, the foundation offers a natural make-up result that resembles a second skin. Imperfections are blurred, and the complexion is radiant. The medium, buildable coverage evens out and enhances the complexion, all day long. The foundation resists heat, humidity and perspiration: once applied to the skin, the color remains true all through the day.
 
 EFFECTIVE SKINCARE
 Formulated with an 82% skincare base**, the luminous matte skincare foundation offers immediate and lasting results on the skin.
 Its moisturizing, revitalizing performance comes from a trio of active ingredients: niacinamide to nourish, smooth and improve skin quality, pure hyaluronic acid for moisturization and white mulberry extract (Morus alba L.), an antioxidant that plumps the skin while protecting it from oxidative stress.
 Two hours after application, 100% of people questioned found that their skin felt more moisturized.***
 With regular use:
 – 91% of people noticed an improvement in the overall appearance of their skin.****
 – 85% of people said that their skin was firmer.****
 – 87% of people said that their skin had regained its elasticity.****
 – 82% of people said that wrinkles and fine lines had been smoothed out.****
 – 86% of people said that their skin was plumper.****
 
 THE FORMULA
 This skincare foundation comprises 71% ingredients of natural origin. It has been formulated with rigorously selected active ingredients to enhance and care for the skin. The non-comedogenic formula has been dermatologically tested to ensure its suitability for all skin types, including the more sensitive ones.
 
 THE COLOR
 Épicéa is a neutral beige with a hint of apricot.
 
 Gregoris Pyrpylis has created a range of shades to suit all skin tones, gracing every complexion with a perfectly balanced result that looks and feels like a second skin. Three undertones are available: warm (W), cool (C) and neutral (N), to bring out the full radiance of each skin tone.
 Which undertone suits you best?
 Warm (W): for skin with a pink, apricot or copper tone.
 Cool (C): for skin with a golden, ocher or bronze tone.
 Neutral (N): for skin with no particular dominant tone.
 
 THE GESTURE
 To apply the luminous matte skincare foundation to the face, use the Le Perfecteur brush or the fingertips. The coverage can be adjusted by varying the amount applied, for results ranging from the most natural to the highly sophisticated. For greater coverage or to blur imperfections, simply tap a little extra onto specific areas.
 A range of bespoke complexion tools has also been created, to accompany your daily beauty routine and help you apply these complexion products in a manner that is hygienic, precise and tailored to your individual requirements.
 
 THE OBJECT
 The bottle was designed by Pierre Hardy, creator of Hermès Beauty objects. Its clean, graphic lines combine the circle and the square and are crafted in noble materials. The glass is partly frosted, partly transparent, playing with our perceptions. The black metal pump, engraved with the Hermès Paris signature, delivers just the right amount for one application. And the black and white metal cap with its jewel-like finish is decorated with the Hermès Ex-Libris in gold permabrass.
 
 * Self-scoring by a panel of 55 volunteers
 ** Percentage does not include pigments and powders.
 *** Instrumental test carried out on 11 women.
 **** Self-assessment by 55 volunteers after 28 days of use.

name: Rituel De Fille 3 Drop Weightless Serum Foundation
description:
3 Drop Weightless Serum Foundation works like magic for a truly transformative yet utterly natural effect. This innovative formula smooths and unifies the complexion, yet is as weightless and intuitively easy to apply as a serum. The remarkable medium-coverage formula imparts a softly diffused, subtly luminous finish.
3 Drop Weightless Serum Foundation is the first product to market in any category, including skincare, to contain the truly innovative and sustainable new active carotenoid ingredient: fermented phytoene. This is the first pure phytoene ever extracted, and this ingredient offers both remarkable short-term and long-term benefits. Clinical trials have shown it to protect against free radicals, brighten and smooth skin, enhance firmness and elasticity, and support the skin barrier among its many long-term benefits.
HOW TO APPLY:
It only takes 3 drops of this magic potion to transform your skin and create a glowy natural finish.
Shake well. Press the soft underside of the bottle to dispense onto fingertips. Apply gently to the face.
Tip: 3 drops achieves medium coverage. If desired, use fewer for lighter coverage, more for fuller coverage.
Finish: Buildable medium coverage in a glowy natural finishTexture: Lightweight oil; never sticky, never greasy, never dryingAroma: Fragrance-free and made without any essential oils. You may notice the subtle scents of jojoba and marula oils.
Key Ingredients:
ORGANIC JOJOBA OILThe very first ingredient in the formula, this golden oil comes from the seeds of the Simmondsia chinensis shrub native to California, Arizona and northern Mexico. It is extraordinarily similar to the oils produced by skin, so it is particularly moisturizing and gentle for face and body.ORGANIC MARULA OILThis is a wonderfully lightweight oil that absorbs effortlessly into skin, creating a supple texture. Marula oil is rich in antioxidants and contributes to overall radiance.MCT OILThis thin, lightweight elixir is non-comedogenic and extremely stable. Short for "medium-chain triglyceride," this is a special fraction of coconut oil resulting from the more unstable fatty acids being removed. (INCI: Caprylic/Capric Triglycerides)PURE FERMENTED PHYTOENE IN JD PHYTO-OR 1%Phytoene is a carotenoid that has just been isolated for the first time ever, and this is the very first beauty product to ever be formulated with it. Made from fermented mycelium and jojoba oil, this hyper-potent active brightens, smooths and soothes. Read more about this exciting new active.
Ingredients: Simmondsia Chinensis (Jojoba) Seed Oil*, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Sclerocarya Birrea (Marula) Seed Oil*, Jojoba Esters, Tapioca Starch, Hydrogenated Ethylhexyl Olivate, Quaternium-90 Sepiolite, Quaternium-90 Montmorillonite, Blakeslea Trispora Mycelium Extract/C30-45 Olefin, Ricinus Communis Seed Oil, Phytosterols, Rosmarinus Officinalis (Rosemary) Leaf Extract*, Helianthus Annuus (Sunflower Seed) Oil, Tocopherol
May Contain: Iron Oxides (CI 77492, CI 77491, CI 77499), Titanium Dioxide, Coco-Caprylate/Caprate, Polyglyceryl-6 Polyricinoleate, Polyhydroxystearic Acid, Dilinoleic Acid/Butanediol Copolymer, Castor Oil/IPDI Copolymer, Disodium Stearoyl Glutamate
*Certified Organic

name: Rituel De Fille 3 Drop Weightless Serum Foundation
description:
3 Drop Weightless Serum Foundation works like magic for a truly transformative yet utterly natural effect. This innovative formula smooths and unifies the complexion, yet is as weightless and intuitively easy to apply as a serum. The remarkable medium-coverage formula imparts a softly diffused, subtly luminous finish.
3 Drop Weightless Serum Foundation is the first product to market in any category, including skincare, to contain the truly innovative and sustainable new active carotenoid ingredient: fermented phytoene. This is the first pure phytoene ever extracted, and this ingredient offers both remarkable short-term and long-term benefits. Clinical trials have shown it to protect against free radicals, brighten and smooth skin, enhance firmness and elasticity, and support the skin barrier among its many long-term benefits.
HOW TO APPLY:
It only takes 3 drops of this magic potion to transform your skin and create a glowy natural finish.
Shake well. Press the soft underside of the bottle to dispense onto fingertips. Apply gently to the face.
Tip: 3 drops achieves medium coverage. If desired, use fewer for lighter coverage, more for fuller coverage.
Finish: Buildable medium coverage in a glowy natural finishTexture: Lightweight oil; never sticky, never greasy, never dryingAroma: Fragrance-free and made without any essential oils. You may notice the subtle scents of jojoba and marula oils.
Key Ingredients:
ORGANIC JOJOBA OILThe very first ingredient in the formula, this golden oil comes from the seeds of the Simmondsia chinensis shrub native to California, Arizona and northern Mexico. It is extraordinarily similar to the oils produced by skin, so it is particularly moisturizing and gentle for face and body.ORGANIC MARULA OILThis is a wonderfully lightweight oil that absorbs effortlessly into skin, creating a supple texture. Marula oil is rich in antioxidants and contributes to overall radiance.MCT OILThis thin, lightweight elixir is non-comedogenic and extremely stable. Short for "medium-chain triglyceride," this is a special fraction of coconut oil resulting from the more unstable fatty acids being removed. (INCI: Caprylic/Capric Triglycerides)PURE FERMENTED PHYTOENE IN JD PHYTO-OR 1%Phytoene is a carotenoid that has just been isolated for the first time ever, and this is the very first beauty product to ever be formulated with it. Made from fermented mycelium and jojoba oil, this hyper-potent active brightens, smooths and soothes. Read more about this exciting new active.
Ingredients: Simmondsia Chinensis (Jojoba) Seed Oil*, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Sclerocarya Birrea (Marula) Seed Oil*, Jojoba Esters, Tapioca Starch, Hydrogenated Ethylhexyl Olivate, Quaternium-90 Sepiolite, Quaternium-90 Montmorillonite, Blakeslea Trispora Mycelium Extract/C30-45 Olefin, Ricinus Communis Seed Oil, Phytosterols, Rosmarinus Officinalis (Rosemary) Leaf Extract*, Helianthus Annuus (Sunflower Seed) Oil, Tocopherol
May Contain: Iron Oxides (CI 77492, CI 77491, CI 77499), Titanium Dioxide, Coco-Caprylate/Caprate, Polyglyceryl-6 Polyricinoleate, Polyhydroxystearic Acid, Dilinoleic Acid/Butanediol Copolymer, Castor Oil/IPDI Copolymer, Disodium Stearoyl Glutamate
*Certified Organic

- 94% showed brighter skin

- 94% showed more radiant skin

This innovative Korean skincare-infused foundation delivers a natural, semi-matte finish that promotes a radiant glow, keeping your skin looking fresh and perfected for up to 72 hours. Perfect for those seeking to enhance their skincare routine with effective, hybrid makeup, this cushion ensures your skin barrier feels supported while offering essential hydration and moisture for a healthy appearance.

Key Benefits

    
High Coverage: Visibly conceals blemishes and reduces the appearance of redness for a smoother, more even complexion.
    
Long-Lasting Wear: The advanced formula is crafted to maintain its impeccable finish for up to 72 hours, helping to minimize the need for frequent touch-ups throughout your day.
    
Lightweight & Comfortable: Experience a feather-light sensation on your skin, ensuring comfort without any heavy or cakey feel, even with its impressive coverage.
    
Nourishing Formula: Enriched with beneficial ingredients that work to support and maintain healthy-looking skin, contributing to improved skin radiance.


Key Ingredients
The TIRTIR Mask Fit Red Cushion is thoughtfully formulated with skin-loving ingredients to offer more than just coverage:

    
Niacinamide: Also known as Vitamin B3, Niacinamide helps improve the appearance of skin tone and radiance. It may also help support a healthy skin barrier and balance the look of excess oil.
    
Propolis Extract: Known for its supportive properties, propolis extract may help maintain skin's balance and can contribute to a smoother, more radiant complexion.
    
Hibiscus Flower Extract: This botanical extract is recognized for its ability to help maintain skin hydration, leaving skin feeling soft and supple. It also offers antioxidant properties that help protect the skin from environmental stressors.


How to Use
Achieving a flawless finish with your TIRTIR Mask Fit Red Cushion (Base Makeup) is simple:

    
Prep Your Skin: Begin with a cleansed and moisturized face to create an optimal canvas for application.
    
Apply the Cushion: Gently press the included puff onto the cushion to pick up a moderate amount of the product.
    
Pat Gently: Lightly tap the puff across your face, starting from the center and blending outwards for an even, natural-looking application.
    
Layer as Needed: For areas requiring additional coverage or to build up your desired look, apply another thin layer using the same gentle patting motion.
    
Finish Your Look: Complete your makeup routine with your preferred products.

name: Blurring Ceramide Cream Foundation
description:
About MOB Beauty Blurring Ceramide Cream Foundation

The skincare-packed MOB Beauty Blurring Ceramide Cream Foundation is a foundation and concealer hybrid that blurs and diffuses the skin with multi-dimensional mineral technology. Ceramide 2 holds moisture in the skin and repairs the skin barrier while award-winning, small-molecule hyaluronic acid visibly plumps with hydration. A powerful cocktail of anti-inflammatories and antioxidants soothes and protects, and its unique waterless formula keeps its color all day. Available in 4 undertones, enhance your skin tone with lasting, flexible coverage and a natural, radiant finish.

Why It's Special

A foundation and concealer hybrid made with a complex blend of multi-dimensional pigments that deliver a diffused blur and a natural-radiant light bounce
Ceramide 2, sourced from Korea, decreases epidermal water loss while protecting the skin’s barrier
Award-winning, small-molecule hyaluronic acid visibly plumps and hydrates, leaving skin supple, nourished, and refreshed
Avocado oil gives the formula creamy blendability while natural sugar polymers offer flexible comfort, skin adhesion, and long wear
Anti-inflammatories bisabolol and phytosphingosine calm the skin and soothe redness
Unique waterless formula easily builds to full coverage and doesn’t change color during wear
Outer box and compact are made with post-consumer recycled materials and are biodegradable thus can be recycled or simply discarded after use. Product pan refill can be popped out and should be recycled when empty. Create your own personalized palette by popping the pan out of the compact and into MOB's endlessly refillable and customizable palettes.

How to Use

Apply with fingers, brush, or sponge to the face and under eye area as a foundation and/or concealer and build to your desired coverage.

Other Details

Awarded Cosmopolitan’s Best Clean Foundation of 2024

Vegan

name: Blurring Ceramide Cream Foundation
description:
About MOB Beauty Blurring Ceramide Cream Foundation

The skincare-packed MOB Beauty Blurring Ceramide Cream Foundation is a foundation and concealer hybrid that blurs and diffuses the skin with multi-dimensional mineral technology. Ceramide 2 holds moisture in the skin and repairs the skin barrier while award-winning, small-molecule hyaluronic acid visibly plumps with hydration. A powerful cocktail of anti-inflammatories and antioxidants soothes and protects, and its unique waterless formula keeps its color all day. Available in 4 undertones, enhance your skin tone with lasting, flexible coverage and a natural, radiant finish.

Why It's Special

A foundation and concealer hybrid made with a complex blend of multi-dimensional pigments that deliver a diffused blur and a natural-radiant light bounce
Ceramide 2, sourced from Korea, decreases epidermal water loss while protecting the skin’s barrier
Award-winning, small-molecule hyaluronic acid visibly plumps and hydrates, leaving skin supple, nourished, and refreshed
Avocado oil gives the formula creamy blendability while natural sugar polymers offer flexible comfort, skin adhesion, and long wear
Anti-inflammatories bisabolol and phytosphingosine calm the skin and soothe redness
Unique waterless formula easily builds to full coverage and doesn’t change color during wear
Outer box and compact are made with post-consumer recycled materials and are biodegradable thus can be recycled or simply discarded after use. Product pan refill can be popped out and should be recycled when empty. Create your own personalized palette by popping the pan out of the compact and into MOB's endlessly refillable and customizable palettes.

How to Use

Apply with fingers, brush, or sponge to the face and under eye area as a foundation and/or concealer and build to your desired coverage.

Other Details

Awarded Cosmopolitan’s Best Clean Foundation of 2024
Size: 3.5 g
Vegan

description:
About MOB Beauty Blurring Ceramide Cream Foundation

The skincare-packed MOB Beauty Blurring Ceramide Cream Foundation is a foundation and concealer hybrid that blurs and diffuses the skin with multi-dimensional mineral technology. Ceramide 2 holds moisture in the skin and repairs the skin barrier while award-winning, small-molecule hyaluronic acid visibly plumps with hydration. A powerful cocktail of anti-inflammatories and antioxidants soothes and protects, and its unique waterless formula keeps its color all day. Available in 4 undertones, enhance your skin tone with lasting, flexible coverage and a natural, radiant finish.

Why It's Special

A foundation and concealer hybrid made with a complex blend of multi-dimensional pigments that deliver a diffused blur and a natural-radiant light bounce
Ceramide 2, sourced from Korea, decreases epidermal water loss while protecting the skin’s barrier
Award-winning, small-molecule hyaluronic acid visibly plumps and hydrates, leaving skin supple, nourished, and refreshed
Avocado oil gives the formula creamy blendability while natural sugar polymers offer flexible comfort, skin adhesion, and long wear
Anti-inflammatories bisabolol and phytosphingosine calm the skin and soothe redness
Unique waterless formula easily builds to full coverage and doesn’t change color during wear
Outer box and compact are made with post-consumer recycled materials and are biodegradable thus can be recycled or simply discarded after use. Product pan refill can be popped out and should be recycled when empty. Create your own personalized palette by popping the pan out of the compact and into MOB's endlessly refillable and customizable palettes.

How to Use

Apply with fingers, brush, or sponge to the face and under eye area as a foundation and/or concealer and build to your desired coverage.

name: Charlotte Tilbury Hollywood Flawless Filter
description:
Product Details

Complexion booster by Charlotte Tilbury

Three, two, one, glow
Customizable hybrid complexion booster
Combines the blurring properties of a primer and the radiant glow of a highlighter
Aims to lift complexion and mimic the effects of a filter in real life
Liquid formula hydrates skin for up-to 24 hours
Offers a dewy, soft-focus finish for illuminated skin
Antioxidant-rich porcelain flower extract works to enhance microcirculation and help brighten skin
While smoothing polymers and finely-milled powders blend into the skin for a poreless finish
Product is non-returnable for hygiene reasons

Product Code: 1950589

Brand

Charlotte Tilbury is a pretty huge deal. With over 27 years’ experience in the beauty industry (major), the world-famous British makeup artist’s namesake makeup and skincare range is coveted by everyone from supermodels and celebrities to experts, novices and, well, us. Prep like a pro with primers and foundations, or try award-winning lipsticks and eyeshadow quads in our Charlotte Tilbury at ASOS edit. Create a supercharged Hollywood facial at home with the brand’s ‘magic’ moisturizer, too – because who doesn’t love a multi-talented cream?

Size & Fit

Product size: 30ml

How to use

Apply all over the skin as a primer for a subtle glow
Blend with foundation for a brighter finish
Dot along the tops of the cheekbones, down the nose and above the Cupid’s bow to highlight and enhance
Wear alone for a fresh, glossy glow

name: Blurring Ceramide Cream Foundation
description:
About MOB Beauty Blurring Ceramide Cream Foundation

The skincare-packed MOB Beauty Blurring Ceramide Cream Foundation is a foundation and concealer hybrid that blurs and diffuses the skin with multi-dimensional mineral technology. Ceramide 2 holds moisture in the skin and repairs the skin barrier while award-winning, small-molecule hyaluronic acid visibly plumps with hydration. A powerful cocktail of anti-inflammatories and antioxidants soothes and protects, and its unique waterless formula keeps its color all day. Available in 4 undertones, enhance your skin tone with lasting, flexible coverage and a natural, radiant finish.

Why It's Special

A foundation and concealer hybrid made with a complex blend of multi-dimensional pigments that deliver a diffused blur and a natural-radiant light bounce
Ceramide 2, sourced from Korea, decreases epidermal water loss while protecting the skin’s barrier
Award-winning, small-molecule hyaluronic acid visibly plumps and hydrates, leaving skin supple, nourished, and refreshed
Avocado oil gives the formula creamy blendability while natural sugar polymers offer flexible comfort, skin adhesion, and long wear
Anti-inflammatories bisabolol and phytosphingosine calm the skin and soothe redness
Unique waterless formula easily builds to full coverage and doesn’t change color during wear
Outer box and compact are made with post-consumer recycled materials and are biodegradable thus can be recycled or simply discarded after use. Product pan refill can be popped out and should be recycled when empty. Create your own personalized palette by popping the pan out of the compact and into MOB's endlessly refillable and customizable palettes.

How to Use

Apply with fingers, brush, or sponge to the face and under eye area as a foundation and/or concealer and build to your desired coverage.

Other Details

Awarded Cosmopolitan’s Best Clean Foundation of 2024
Size: 3.5 g
Vegan
Cruelty-free
Paraben-free
Silicone-free
Phthalates-free
Gluten-free
Leaping Bunny and PETA certified
Free of alcohol, gluten, and soy

name: Luminous Silk Foundation Liquid Foundation
description:
Luminous Silk Foundation – A fluid foundation with a radiant finish that transforms your skin.

Armani Beauty's Luminous Silk Foundation is a legendary foundation that delivers a luminous, natural finish inspired by the texture of silk. Its lightweight, fluid formula melts into the skin to even out skin tone, blur imperfections, and provide a soft glow without a mask-like effect. This foundation is ideal for those seeking radiant, healthy-looking, and perfected skin with an almost imperceptible feel.

Its advanced technology works to reflect light elegantly, making the complexion look smoother and with a uniform and sophisticated appearance, both in everyday life and on special occasions.

UP TO 24H OF LUMINOSITY, LASTING* AND HYDRATION**

24 hours* duration
Enriched with niacinamide
Natural gloss finish
24 hours** of hydration and comfort
Lightweight texture

It provides a radiant yet natural finish, evens skin tone, and softens the appearance of the skin. The complexion looks smoother, fresher, and with an elegant glow that lasts for hours, without looking cakey or heavy.

Application

First, apply LUMINOUS SILK ILLUMINATING PRIMER to prepare the skin.
Apply LUMINOUS SILK FOUNDATION with a brush or sponge for a perfect finish.
Add one layer for light coverage and build more layers for medium coverage.
Mix with LUMINOUS SILK ILLUMINATING PRIMER or FLUID SHEER for a radiant look.

Discover Armani beauty's iconic LUMINOUS SILK FOUNDATION, in a newly improved formula that blends more skin-true shades with new skincare actives.

name: Original Pure Serum Found-4,5-Medium Deep Cool
description:
Original Pure Serum Liquid Foundation from bareMinerals is an innovative liquid foundation that combines the power of a hydrating serum with the coverage of a foundation. The formula is designed to provide a luminous, natural finish whilst offering skincare benefits. Enriched with natural ingredients such as marula oil and hyaluronic acid, this product hydrates and improves the skin''s appearance over time. With its light and fluid texture, the foundation adapts easily to the skin, providing fresh and radiant coverage, perfect for a natural and luminous look. Ideal for normal to dry skin, this foundation also offers additional care to keep the skin hydrated and nourished.

Active Ingredients:
The formula is enriched with marula oil, which is known for its moisturizing and nourishing properties, leaving skin soft and supple. Hyaluronic acid helps maintain skin hydration throughout the day, while glycerin offers moisture-retaining properties. Other key ingredients include green tea extract, which has antioxidant properties, helping to protect the skin against environmental damage. The foundation also contains vitamin E, which helps keep the skin healthy and hydrated.

Texture and Skin Type:
The texture of the foundation is fluid and light, providing easy application and natural coverage. Ideal for normal to dry skin, the formula offers long-lasting hydration without weighing it down or drying it out. Despite having a luminous finish, the product does not leave the skin oily, making it suitable for those looking for natural, radiant coverage.

Target Audience:
This foundation is recommended for those looking for light to medium coverage with a luminous and natural finish, and is especially ideal for normal to dry skin. People with dehydrated skin or those looking for a product that provides skin care, such as hydration and nutrition, will find the Original Pure Serum Liquid Foundation a perfect ally for their daily life.

Complementary Products:
For a more radiant look, combine with BareMinerals Gen Nude Highlighter and finish with BareMinerals Original Loose Mineral Veil for a soft, mattifying finishing touch. For even more hydrated skin, use BareMinerals Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Serum before applying foundation.

name: Flawless Everlast Foundation - 5N - 30ml
description:
Dolce & Gabbana''s Flawless Everlast Foundation SPF20 is a foundation designed to provide a perfectly even complexion with a sophisticated finish that reflects the characteristic elegance of the Italian brand. Developed for long-lasting wear, it keeps skin flawless from morning to night, resisting humidity, heat, and natural wear and tear. Its formula combines high-performance technology with skin-caring ingredients, guaranteeing medium to high coverage without a mask-like effect and with a light, comfortable feel.

This foundation was created for those seeking a balance between makeup and skincare, offering SPF20 sun protection to help prevent damage caused by daily sun exposure. Its composition adapts to the needs of modern skin, providing continuous hydration, smoothness, and a natural finish that enhances the natural luminosity of each face.

Thanks to its easy-to-spread texture and flawless finish, the Flawless Everlast Foundation SPF20 is ideal for elevating any look—from the simplest and most casual to the most elaborate. Its ability to remain intact for hours makes it a top choice for those who prioritize quality, luxury, and performance in a single product.

Active Ingredients:

Long-Lasting Hydration Complex: Keeps skin hydrated throughout the day.

SPF20 Sunscreen Filters: Protect against UV rays.

High-Definition Pigments: Ensure even coverage and a natural finish.

Texture and Skin Type:
Fluid, lightweight, and comfortable texture, suitable for all skin types, including dry, normal, combination, and oily skin.

Target Audience:
Recommended for those seeking a luxurious foundation with a long-lasting finish, sun protection, and even coverage, ideal for daily use or special occasions.

Complementary Products:

For a flawless finish, it is recommended to use in conjunction with:

Dolce & Gabbana Millennialskin Primer – To prepare and smooth the skin.

Dolce & Gabbana The Concealer – To precisely correct imperfections.

name: HD SKIN HYDRA GLOW SAMPLE - TRY BEFORE YOU BUY
description:
Sample pots to try before you buy! Limited to one of each shade as these are intended to assist with colour matching and not to replace product.
Each sample contains 6 pumps of product: sufficient for one full face. Samples are intended for colour matching and not to replace product, with this in mind we limit to 1 of each shade.
A hybrid foundation that merges skincare benefits with complexion coverage. Formulated for those seeking extra hydration, especially dry, sensitive, or mature skin types. Buildable from light to medium coverage.

86% skincare-heavy formula lasts up to 24 hours, delivering a natural, blurred, unified complexion
Biopolymer complex with Hyaluronic Acid and Glycols mimics sheet-mask hydration for all-day comfort

Results: luminous, plumped, hydrated skin that unifies subtly while letting your natural complexion shine through. It is like applying a hydrating sheet mask before your foundation providing the maximum skin glow.
Shade Selection – 38 Inclusive Colours
Step 1: Pick your shade family (1= Light, 2= Medium, 3= Tan, 4= Deep)
Step 2: Choose undertone—R = Red, N = Neutral, Y = Yellow. Check your wrist veins: blue = cool, green = warm
Step 3: Select intensity using the face charts in product images
Each sample contains 6 pumps—enough for one full face or shade match. Limit: 1 sample per shade..
Ethical:

Cruelty-free, no animal-derived ingredients

name: Clinique Superbalanced Makeup, 1 oz
description:
What is it: The great equalizer for combination skin. Superbalanced foundation provides moisture and absorbs oil where needed to help give skin a naturally perfected look.

Who is it for: Women with very dry to combination oily skin who want a skin-balancing makeup with sheer-to-moderate coverage.

Why is it different: Superbalanced makeup provides adjustable coverage that is silky upon application. The oil-free formula imparts a natural-looking finish. Allergy tested. 100% fragrance free.

How do I use it: Apply with a foundation brush or fingertips, starting in the center of the face and blending outward. For a seamless look, dampen fingertips and blend edges. Can be worn in the immediate eye area.

description: I bought it from another site because they didn’t have the shade I needed here. It’s a great foundation with solid coverage that smooths the look of pores. The bottle is gorgeous. Just make sure your skin is well moisturized—if it’s dry or flaky, it can cling and emphasize those areas. I got shade 07N, which is perfect for summer. I’m not super fair. It’s similar to Dior 1N (I have the stick, and if you’ve tried it, you know it’s not very light), but without the pink undertone—more of a warm beige. It wears pretty well and has a velvety finish.

name: Ultra Le Teint All Day Comfort - BD11 - 30ml
description:
Ultra Le Teint All Day Comfort by Chanel is a high-quality foundation that offers medium to high coverage for the skin. Its lightweight and comfortable formula provides a smooth and even application, leaving the skin with a natural and radiant finish. With long-lasting and transfer-resistant properties, this foundation ensures a flawless appearance throughout the day while keeping the skin hydrated and comfortable.

Active Ingredients:Hyaluronic Acid: hydrates the skin, helping to keep it soft and smooth.High-quality pigments: provide perfect coverage, concealing imperfections and evening out the skin tone.Fixing Polymers: provide long-lasting wear to the foundation, keeping it intact for hours and resistant to transfer.

Texture and Skin Type:It has a lightweight and creamy texture that easily blends into the skin. It is suitable for all skin types, including dry, normal, and combination skin. Its hydrating formula provides comfort throughout the day, preventing dryness and a tight feeling.

Target Audience:Perfect for anyone who desires medium to high coverage with a natural and long-lasting finish. It is ideal for those seeking a high-quality, comfortable, and long-wearing foundation. It is suitable for daily use or special occasions.

Complementary Products:For best results, it is recommended to prepare the skin with Chanel skincare products before applying the foundation. Additionally, a facial primer can be used to prolong the wear and fixation of the foundation. It is also recommended to use a setting powder to seal the foundation and control shine throughout the day.

name: Impeccable Blurring Second-Skin Matte Foundation
description:
Introducing Anastasia Beverly Hills Impeccable Foundation: a medium to full-coverage, long-wearing formula that blurs pores, fine lines and wrinkles for up to 12 hours. Powered by Precision Blur Technology, this hydrating velvet-matte foundation features Hyaluronic Acid for a smooth, flawless finish and second-skin feel.

WHY YOU’LL LOVE IT
Velvet-matte medium to full coverage foundation with a natural, second-skin finish
Long-wearing up to 12 hours + water-resistant
Weightless, water-based formula effortlessly blends and builds
Hydrates skin with hyaluronic acid to maintain plump, bouncy skin
Blurs, smooths and minimizes pores, fine lines, wrinkles and texture
Visibly evens skin tone and masks discoloration, redness and blemishes
Non-slip, non-cakey formula doesn’t melt, separate or settle into lines
No-flashback formula doesn’t self-set or oxidize for a natural finish
Pairs perfectly with liquid, cream, and powder finishes
Ideal for all skin types – especially oily skin
Luxe, custom-molded component
Available in 25 flexible shades and undertones
Dermatologist-tested, non-comedogenic and safe for sensitive skin
Cruelty-free and vegan

FREE OF:
Phthalates, Gluten, Mineral Oil, Talc, Sulfates, Parabens, Oil and Fragrance

HIGHLIGHTED INGREDIENTS
HYALURONIC ACID helps to provide moisture and a plumping effect.
BIXA ORELLANA helps to blur pores and imperfections.
PHYTOGLYCOGEN helps to deliver youthful, radiant skin.

In an independent study of 100 women:
100% agree it instantly masks imperfections and discoloration.
99% agree their skin doesn’t look oily or shiny after applying it.
98% agree their skin looks more even after applying it.
96% agree it gives my skin a natural, soft-matte finish.

HOW TO APPLY
• Prep skin with water-based formulas.
• For dry skin, pair with a hydrating primer. For oily skin, pair with a mattifying primer.
• Using 1-2 pumps, start by applying in the center of the face and blend outwards. Pair with a brush for full coverage or a beauty sponge for lighter coverage. Focus on desired areas to build coverage as needed.
• To brighten and conceal, pair with Magic Touch Concealer.
• Set complexion with Impeccable Setting Spray to set, blur and mattify with 24HR wear.

PRO TIPS
• Pair with non-oil-based formulas for optimal results.
• For dry skin types, prep skin with hydration before application.
• To build coverage, use pressing motions in the desired area.
• The velvet-matte finish can be set to your preference.
• Pair with Loose Setting Powder for an extra, locked-in complexion.

name: Your Skin But Better Foundation + Skincare
description:
Description

Experience an instantly better-looking complexion and better bare skin in just two weeks with Your Skin But Better Hydrating Foundation + Skincare! This buildable, medium coverage foundation minimizes the look of pores and imperfections while delivering all-day hydration and wear with a natural radiant finish. Suitable for all skin types and infused with hyaluronic acid, aloe vera extract, plus vitamins E & B5, your skin-loving lightweight foundation goes beyond a tinted moisturizer by working behind the scenes as you wear it. After just two weeks, skin looks smoother, skin tone appears more even and skin texture is visibly refined. IT’s truly your foundation for better skin—even when you’re not wearing IT!

Benefits

- Hydrating foundation with buildable, medium coverage.

- Micro-fine pearl powder provides a natural radiant finish

- Hyaluronic Acid & Aloe Vera Extract: Instantly hydrate and smooth the look of skin

- Vitamins E & B5: Moisturize the skin and fight free radicals to help strengthen the skin barrier

- Hepes Acid: Gently exfoliates for a brighter-looking complexion

Usage

Shake well and apply 1-2 pumps to clean skin using your Heavenly Skin™ Skin-Smoothing Brush #704 or favorite IT Cosmetics foundation brush. For best results, start at the center of your face and blend outward.

name: Prisme Libre Glow Serum Foundation
description: Givenchy's Prisme Libre Glow Serum Foundation pairs serum-like hydration with the correcting effect of foundation to blur the look of imperfections, refine the appearance of texture, and create a fresh, lit-from-within glow that still reads like skin. Its lightweight, buildable formula evens the look of tone with dewy coverage that can be worn sheer or layered up, while settling into a comfortable, skin-nourishing finish designed for daily wear.The result is a soft, even veil that feels light on the face, keeps skin looking bright and smooth, and maintains a natural sheen throughout the day without sacrificing comfort.

name: CC+ Color Correcting Full Coverage Cream SPF 50+
description:
What it is: A color-correcting cream that works beautifully as your full-coverage foundation, hydrating anti-aging serum and sunscreen.

Who it's for: All skin types.

What it does: Developed with plastic surgeons, this multitasking beauty miracle provides clinically tested hydration while diffusing the look of skin imperfections for flawless-looking coverage that won't crease or crack. Infused with hydrolyzed collagen, peptides, niacin, hyaluronic acid, antioxidants and vitamins, this skin-loving full-coverage foundation reduces the appearance of acne scarring, wrinkles, redness on skin, dark circles under eyes and large pores—all while giving you a luminous, supple, flawless-looking complexion. It's truly your one step for instant complexion perfection.

How to use: Apply 1–2 pumps to clean skin using a makeup brush for effortless buffing and blending. The cream can be used as your moisturizer, anti-aging serum, concealer, full-coverage foundation and sunscreen for face, based on your coverage needs. For best results, apply a smooth, even layer to your face, neck and décolleté for complexion perfection. Focus on parts of your face that may need the most coverage first, such as under your eyes, around your nose and mouth, chin and center of forehead—all of which typically require color correction for uneven skin tone.

name: Phyto-Blanc Le Cushion
description:
About Sisley-Paris Phyto-Blanc Le Cushion

The technology of the next-generation Phyto-Blanc Complex in a cushion compact foundation. Sisley-Paris Phyto-Blanc Le Cushion immediately melts into skin to reveal a fresh, luminous, and even complexion. Blemishes appear blurred and pores look minimized with a naturally radiant, bare-skin finish. With every application, skin looks clearer and more luminous and dark spots appear diminished. Skin feels more hydrated and protected on a daily basis due to powerful anti-pollution and anti-free radical protection.

Why It’s Special

Patented Phyto-Blanc Complex visibly brightens and evens the complexion and enhances radiance
Peach blossom extract boosts the complexion’s radiance
Vegetable-derived sugars and provitamin B5 support long-lasting hydration
Buckwheat seed extract and a vitamin E derivative protect the skin against external aggressors, such as pollution, fine particles, and free radicals

How to Use

Pick up a small amount of the formula with the cushion applicator, then use a press and roll motion to apply across the entire face. Continue to layer as needed to adjust your coverage and create a tailor-made natural glow. Reapply during the day if desired. Wash the sponge regularly with soap and mild shampoo, rinse well, and let air dry.

Other Details

Size: 15 g
Oil-free
Non-comedogenic

description:
It's the first anti-aging serum and foundation product in one bottle.  Created in Italy using highly innovative, time-release color pigment technology and a serious new skincare ingredient (Juvenessence), brought together in a state-of-the-art manufacturing process.  

Key Benefits:
• Provides flawless, buildable, natural-looking coverage while helping diminish the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles 
• Minimizes the appearance of pores and helps refine and "refinish" skin texture
• Imparts a younger-looking, more luminous, natural glow to the skin
• Lightweight, extra-fine formulation makes it easy to melt into the skin 
• Highly concentrated formula with no water, no oil, no parabens
• Powder-free and non-comedogenic

The Supporting Technology:
• Optical diffusers help "blur" skin imperfections to create a "soft focus" effect
• Special time-release dispersion of color pigments provides continuous coverage for 6-8 hours
• Powerful marine-based algae extract ingredient (Juvenessence) helps reactivate the metabolism of aging cells to better ward off the production of Progerin (the protein that accelerates the skin's aging process), so skin "acts" younger
• Younger-acting skin is younger-looking skin
 
Made in the Italy for Ready To Wear®

Provides full coverage with a satin finish that blurs imperfections and evens out skin tone, perfect for achieving the coveted “glass skin” look.

FAQs About TIRTIR Mask Fit Red Cushion Mini:

Is the TIRTIR Cushion Foundation worth the hype?

Definitely! The TIRTIR Mask Fit Red Cushion has earned serious recognition including multiple beauty awards. It’s the first Korean cushion foundation to be named Japan’s top cushion of the year at the Cosme Awards – a major feat in a highly competitive market.

What sets this cushion foundation apart is its impressive long-lasting coverage that withstands hot and humid weather. Thanks to its air-layered powder technology, it controls excess oil while giving your skin a soft-focus, airbrushed finish.

Beyond coverage, the TIRTIR cushion foundation doubles as skin care. The formula is packed with nourishing ingredients, keeping your complexion healthy during and after use. It’s gentle, non-comedogenic, and free of parabens and phthalates, making it suitable for all skin types.

Is the TIRTIR Mask Fit Red Cushion Mini water- or silicone-based?

The TIRTIR Mask Fit Red Cushion Mini is a silicone-based cushion foundation. Silicone-based foundation has a silky texture that glides effortlessly over skin. It creates a smooth canvas by blurring the look of pores and fine lines, and dries down quickly for a weightless, non-greasy finish. Silicone-based formulas also usually have more staying power than water-based formulas, which is ideal for all-day wear.

How to find your TIRTIR Cushion shade online?

Finding your perfect TIRTIR Cushion shade starts with figuring out your skin’s undertone. To do so, check the veins on your wrist. Blue or purple veins usually mean cool undertones, greenish veins suggest warm undertones, and a mix of both points to a neutral undertone.

Once you know your undertone, browse online swatches and reviews from people with similar skin tones. TIRTIR cushion foundation shades are labeled by undertone – C for cool, N for neutral and W for warm. Real-life photos from users may be more helpful than studio shots when choosing your shade.

For a try-before-you-buy option, try TIRTIR’s “Find Your Shade” TikTok filter. It lets you virtually test shades in real time using your front camera. Just remember to use natural lighting for the most accurate match.

Our Powder Foundation contains Certified Organic Jojoba Oil infused with Flower Essences, Hydrated Silica, Certified Organic Extracts of Neem, Olive & Raspberry and pure Pearl & Silk Powders which, when combined, creates a powerful blend of vitamins, essential amino acids and proteins to moisturize, protect and soothe your skin. Creates a matte finish.
 
Color-matching: we suggest you try a few samples to make sure you get your correct shade. The first step is figuring out your undertone. Warm undertones are more yellow, while cool tones are more pink, neutral is in the middle. Here is a blog post with more detail. If you need assistance, contact us, we are here to help.
 
Key Ingredients:


Jojoba Oil: Nourishing and hydrating.

Silk: Moisture balancing, contains amino acids & protein.

Pearl: Promotes healthy, lustrous skin.

Allantoin: Stimulates new and healthy tissue growth, a cell proliferant and skin protectant.

Neem: Soothing, moisturizing, antibacterial, antiseptic.

Raspberry: Antioxidant. Supplies Vitamin C and bioflavanoids to skin. Fights free radicals.

Zinc Oxide: Natural UVA & UVB protection. Protects against free radical damage.

Tips:
Choosing the right shade for your skin:

For Yellow/Olive skin tones, choose from our Warm Shades.
For Pink/Red skin tones, use our Cool Shades.
Neutral Shades work well to tone down extra red, sensitive or ruddy skin tones & for many Caucasian skin types.

 

For drier skin types, apply our Organic Facial Serum and allow to absorb into skin before applying Foundation.
For oily skin, use Finishing Powder over Foundation to absorb excess oil.
For heavier coverage, apply in layers with a puff or use Silk Veil as a setting powder after applying Foundation.

An exclusive  blend of skincare actives: Queen of the Night – a soothing, night-blooming flower, niacinamide, hyaluronic acids and botanical oils helps to protect and strengthen the skin barrier. name: bareMinerals Original Loose Mineral Foundation 8g Neutral Ivory 6
description:
Why We Love It
This powder foundation melts onto the skin like cream, offering a natural, smooth finish without dryness, while providing a light and comfortable feel, as though it were not applied.
It perfectly balances oil and moisture, improving the foundation's adherence, and delivers a natural, dewy look with a transparent finish.
The amount of powder can be adjusted to achieve a subtle finish or more complete coverage.
Featured Ingredients
With seven mineral ingredients (red iron oxide, yellow iron oxide, black iron oxide, titanium dioxide, zinc oxide, mica, and bismuth oxychloride), this product keeps skin hydrated and resists oil and humidity, ensuring long-lasting makeup.
The powder is designed in a special container to prevent spillage and is convenient for on-the-go use.
How to Use
1. Dispense a small amount of powder into the lid, pick it up with a brush, and adjust the amount.
2. Press the brush against the skin and blend in circular motions, starting from the chin, then to the cheeks, forehead, and nose, to apply evenly.
Layer on the foundation in the same way for areas that need coverage.
Individual allergic reactions may occur. Do not use this product if you are allergic to any of its ingredients. If irritation occurs, stop use immediately and consult a healthcare professional.

name: Weightless Skin Foundation SPF 15
description:
Item #20511808

What It Is:
A long-wear foundation that delivers 24-hour moisture and 24-hour wear for a natural matte finish that looks like skin, not makeup. Formulated with the brand's Smart Skin-Balancing Technology, this lightweight formula controls oil all day without stripping skin, delivering medium coverage that minimizes the look of pores and feels comfortable and breathable. Designed for a range of skin tones, types, and concerns from oily skin to dry skin. The formula is waterproof, sweat/humidity resistant, transfer resistant, fade resistant, crease resistant, non-caking, reduces the look of pores, and non-comedogenic.

How It Works:

Smart Skin-Balancing Technology delivers all-day oil control plus all-day hydration, so skin is left feeling more balanced.
Oil-absorbing silicas help to control oil and shine without stripping moisture.
Tri-Moisture Complex features Hyaluronic Acid, Glycerin, and Honey Extract to help boost skin's moisture levels for immediate and long-term hydration.

How to Use:
Pump onto the back of your hand and buff onto face with a foundation brush—starting at the center or wherever you need it most. Use soft, circular motions for medium coverage or pressing motions for fuller coverage. For lighter coverage that can be done on the go, blend with your fingers. Shake well before applying.

Finish: Natural Matte
Coverage: Medium
Skin Type: All
Skin Undertone: All

Drying alcohol

name: Prada Reveal Skin Optimizing Foundation
description:
Description​

Prada Reveal Skin Optimizing Foundation refines the skin in three dimensions including tone, luminosity and texture to reveal soft-filtered skin in-real-life. The foundation has a breathable, soft matte finish and up to 24-hour wear. This long-lasting, medium buildable coverage foundation is infused with the IRL (In-Real-Life) Micro-FilterTM Technology. This technology consists of a molecule that micro-crystalizes onto the skin. It is transfer-resistant. Formulated with Vitamin E, Niacinamide, and Lactobacillus Extract Complex, the formula improves skin tone, enhances skin’s natural radiance and hydration, and refines skin texture. Broad spectrum SPF 17 sunscreen.

Shades ​

Prada Reveal Foundation is available in 33 flexible-coverage shades. The shades were designed based on an AI-algorithm that scanned 3,000 different skin tones for shade optimization. Made for different skin tones and skin types, including sensitive skin.

Refillable Pack ​

Prada Reveal Foundation is refillable. When reloaded with a consciously designed Prada refill, this reusable protective case contributes to a more responsible use of resources. By reloading your case with a refill, you may use 62% less packaging compared to repurchasing a full foundation**​

​**Based on packaging weight comparison of a full foundation versus a refill.​

​To refill the foundation, simply do the following:​

1. Remove the Prada Reveal Foundation bottle cap​
2. Pull the foundation pump and slide the foundation bottle out of the case​
3. Insert the new refill

name: Maybelline New York
description:
Maybelline New York Fit Me! Matte Fluid Foundation + Poreless 30 ml - Colour: 220 Natural Beige is specially designed for normal to oily skin.

It is formulated to adapt to your skin's color and texture, blurring visible pores and naturally mattifying the skin.

Its lightweight formula, enriched with blurring micro-powders and mattifying clay, refines skin texture and controls shine for an ultra-natural matte complexion.
Skin is mattified, pores visibly smoothed and the complexion naturally beautiful.

Made in France.

name: Tower 28 Beauty SunnyDays SPF 30 Tinted Sunscreen Foundation 30 PCH (1 oz)
description: What it is: A two-in-one natural finish foundation with 100 percent mineral SPF 30, light-medium buildable coverage, and no pore-clogging ingredients, making it safe for problem-prone or sensitive skin. Coverage: Light Finish: Natural Formulation: Liquid SPF: SPF 30 Highlighted Ingredients: - Non-Nano Zinc Oxide: Protects from UVA/UVB damage and is suitable for sensitive skin. - Pricky Pear Extract: Protects from blue light pollution. - White Sage Extract: Is soothing and neutralizes free radicals from the sun. Ingredient Callouts: This product is vegan, gluten-free, and cruelty-free. What Else You Need to Know: This lightweight tinted SPF evens redness, protects from sun damage and blue light, and soothes UV-stressed skin while maintaining a natural finish so your real skin (freckles included!) can have its moment in the sun. The formula is fragrance-free, alcohol-free, nongreasy, non-white-cast, and non-oxidizing—for every sunny day. Clean at Sephora is our commitment to offering effective products without certain ingredients, such as parabens, sulfates, phthalates, and mineral oils. Learn more here. About the brand: Founded by longtime beauty executive Amy Liu, Tower28 is a beauty brand that’s designed for sensitive skin but made for all, with formulas that are 100 percent clean, vegan, and free of every known skin irritant. Named after tower 28, the lifeguard tower on the border of free-spirited Venice and sunny Santa Monica, the LA-based beauty brand is all about that low-maintenance, effortless California style.

description:
TIRTIR Mask Fit Red Cushion is a face primer in a compact that conditions the skin and conceals redness, enlarged pores and other skin imperfections for a radiant finish. It applies easily and stays on the skin for 72 hours!

Hibiscus flower extract: Antioxidant, protects against sunlight, promotes skin regeneration.


Propolis extract: Has antiseptic, soothing and anti-inflammatory properties.


Niacinamide: Strengthens the skin barrier, regulates sebum secretion, has antioxidant, anti-inflammatory and brightening properties, tightens pores.


Physical filters: Protect against UVA and UVB radiation.


Astaxanthin: Powerful antioxidant, increases skin hydration and elasticity.

Pick up a moderate amount of foundation with the supplied can and apply an even layer all over the face using a patting motion.
